title: Learning ibeacon
description:
Discover the power of Bluetooth Low Energy and iBeacon technology with "Learning iBeacon" by Craig Gilchrist. This book teaches iOS developers how to design and develop applications that use proximity sensing and location-based services, enabling advanced user interactions and innovative app experiences.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the fundamentals of iBeacon and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) technology.
Learn to detect iBeacons and develop functionalities such as location-aware user interactions.
Explore the iOS SDK's iBeacon-related features to build reliable and performant applications.
Integrate iBeacons into practical use-cases such as indoor navigation and marketing automation.
Master security considerations when working with iBeacons to ensure robust applications.

Author(s)

Craig Gilchrist is a seasoned iOS developer with years of experience creating innovative apps. His expertise in Bluetooth technologies and proximity-based solutions has led to cutting-edge applications in various industries. Craig is passionate about teaching others through clear and practical explanations, making complex concepts accessible for developers of all levels.

Who is it for?

This book is crafted for iOS developers who are eager to expand their skills into the realm of iBeacon and proximity-based technologies. Ideal readers should have a familiarity with Swift and the iOS SDK, but prior knowledge of iBeacon is not required. If you are someone looking to integrate advanced location functionalities into your apps and explore new interaction paradigms, this book is for you.

title: Scalable VoIP Mobility
description:
Provides practical advice on breaking down the implementation and deployment of voice mobility networks within the office, across the campus, and on the road.
Offers a complete primer on enterprise-grade Wi-Fi networking for voice mobility at scale, whether as a single-mode or dual-mode network, including information on the newest 802.11n standard and how these standards directly impact voice mobility.
Includes methods of integrating existing or new VoIP networks with 3G+, CDMA 2000, WCDMA, HSPA, and WiMAX cellular networks using fixed/mobile convergence (FMC).

This book provides a comprehensive examination of IP-based voice mobility, covering every step in deploying multimodal voice mobility networks. Each segment of the entire voice mobility solution is described with an eye towards the inherent problems of high-scale mobility, from wired infrastructure to end device, across multiple networks and technologies.

Voice mobility is introduced and defined at a basic level before the book examines the high-level components of a scalable voice mobility solution. Chapters focus on several types of transport networks in greater depth, including voice quality metrics and testing, high-density enterprise Wi-Fi voice networks, cellular networks, and high-level networking technologies. The security of VoIP networks is also considered. The book explores standalone VoIP networks and finally provides an investigation of the current and upcoming set of fixed/mobile convergence approaches.

This book is an invaluable guide for anyone looking towards voice mobility as a solution to real-world business problems: IT managers and executives looking to understand the potential for converting offices to all-wireless; network designers and architects planning on rolling out a fully-mobile voice network; and administrators operating or troubleshooting voice mobility networks.

Includes methods of integrating existing or new VoIP networks with 3G+, CDMA 2000, WCDMA, HSPA, and WiMAX cellular networks using fixed/mobile convergence (FMC).

title: Evaluating and Choosing an IoT Platform
description:
With the push for IoT-enabled solutions comes the need for reliable IoT platforms, especially for companies that require industrial-grade IoT capabilities. This O’Reilly report examines various features that heavy-equipment B2B industries should expect in an IoT platform, as well as the key attributes you should be looking for when choosing a platform vendor.

Up to this point, much of the effort in developing an IoT solution has gone into platform building. But if you are to gain a competitive advantage in the marketplace, you can’t afford to build technology stacks from scratch to accommodate hardware, firmware, software, edge computing, analytics, business systems integration, and many other components.

In this report, author Matthew Perry explains what an industrial-grade IoT platform ideally should include, from bidirectional connectivity and distributed computing to availability, scalability, and reliability. You’ll also learn how to assess your IoT strategy and find a vendor that can fulfill your specific needs.

Matthew J. Perry is a writer and editor with a particular interest in how the Internet of Things can make cities smarter. He has written for Cisco Systems and collaborated on ten published books. He lives in New York City.

Hasta este punto, gran parte del esfuerzo para desarrollar una solución IoT ha entrado en la construcción de plataformas. title: IBM Tape Library Guide for Open Systems
description:
This IBM® Redbooks® publication presents a general introduction to the latest (current) IBM tape and tape library technologies. Featured tape technologies include the IBM LTO Ultrium and Enterprise 3592 tape drives, and their implementation in IBM tape libraries.

This 17th edition includes information about the latest TS4300 Ultrium tape library, TS1155 Enterprise tape drive, and the IBM Linear Tape-Open (LTO) Ultrium 8 tape drive, along with technical information about each IBM tape product for open systems. It includes generalized sections about Small Computer System Interface (SCSI) and Fibre Channel connections, and multipath architecture configurations.

This book also covers tools and techniques for library management. It is intended for anyone who wants to understand more about IBM tape products and their implementation. It is suitable for IBM clients, IBM Business Partners, IBM specialist sales representatives, and technical specialists. If you do not have a background in computer tape storage products, you might need to read other sources of information. In the interest of being concise, topics that are generally understood are not covered in detail.

title: The Essential Guide to HTML5: Using Games to Learn HTML5 and JavaScript
description:
HTML5 opens up a plethora of new avenues for application and game development on the web. Games can now be created and interacted with directly within HTML with no need for users to download extra plugins, or for developers to learn new languages. Important new features such as the Canvas tag enable drawing directly onto the web page, the Audio tag allows sounds to be triggered and played from within your HTML code, the web sockets API brings the facility for real-time communication, and the local storage API enables data such as high scores or game preferences to be kept on a user's computer to be retrieved next time they play your game. All of these features and many more are covered within The Essential Guide to HTML5.

This book begins at an introductory level, teaching the essentials of HTML5 and JavaScript through game development. Each chapter features a familiar game type as its core example, such as hangman, rock-paper-scissors, or dice games, and uses these simple constructs to build a solid skillset of the key HTML5 concepts and features. By working through these hands on examples, you will gain a deep, practical knowledge of HTML5 that will enable you to build your own, more advanced games and applications.

Concepts are introduced and motivated with easy-to-grasp, appealing examples.

Code is explained in detail after general explanations.

Reader is guided into how to make the examples "their own".

Los juegos ahora se pueden crear e interactuar con directamente dentro de HTML sin necesidad de que los usuarios descarguen plugins adicionales, o para que los desarrolladores aprendan nuevos idiomas. Las nuevas características importantes como la etiqueta Canvas permiten dibujar directamente en la página web, la etiqueta Audio permite que los sonidos se activan y se reproducen desde dentro de su código HTML, la API de tomas web trae la instalación para la comunicación en tiempo real, y la API de almacenamiento local permite que datos como puntuaciones altas o preferencias de juego se mantengan en el ordenador del usuario para ser recuperados la próxima vez que jueguen su juego. Todas estas características y muchas más están cubiertas en la Guía Esencial del HTML5.

Al trabajar a través de estas manos en ejemplos, obtendrá un conocimiento profundo y práctico de HTML5 que le permitirá construir sus propios juegos y aplicaciones más avanzados.

El código se explica detalladamente después de explicaciones generales.

El lector se guía en cómo hacer los ejemplos "su propio".

title: The Rise and Fall of Greater Syria
description:
The Syrian Social Nationalist Party devoted itself to reviving and unifying the Syrian nation and establishing this nation’s complete independence over its historical homeland, Greater Syria. It continues its struggle today, influencing and shaping Lebanese and Syrian society and politics. Yet, the party remains largely unknown and misunderstood, a condition that stems from the lack of any comprehensive study of it. This book fills this gap.

Syrian nationalism and nationalist movements, generally speaking, have been largely neglected and ignored by historians, scholars, and observers of the Middle East. So, too, has the SSNP. The lack of detailed and nuanced analyses has left significant gaps in the party’s rich history unaddressed and enabled the perpetuation of inaccuracies and misperceptions regarding its past. Given this and the party’s ongoing relevance in Lebanon and Syria, a thorough examination of the early history of the SSNP, the political organization and movement that embodied Syrian nationalism’s most explicit, most cogent expression is even more necessary.

Based on an extensive and thorough examination of Arabic, French, and English primary sources, the monograph is the first comprehensive, systematic history of the SSNP to date, detailing its struggle to fulfill its nationalist vision and establish a secular, independent state in Greater Syria through a thorough analysis of its formation, evolution, and political activities in Lebanon and Syria.
translatedDescription:
El Partido Social Nacionalista Sirio se dedicó a revivir y unificar a la nación siria y establecer la independencia completa de esta nación sobre su patria histórica, la Gran Siria. Continúa su lucha hoy, influenciando y conformando la sociedad y la política libanesa y siria. Sin embargo, el partido sigue siendo en gran medida desconocido e incomprendido, condición que se deriva de la falta de un estudio completo de la misma. Este libro llena esta brecha.

El nacionalismo sirio y los movimientos nacionalistas, generalmente hablando, han sido en gran medida descuidados e ignorados por historiadores, eruditos y observadores del Oriente Medio. Así que, también, tiene la SSNP. La falta de análisis detallados y matizados ha dejado lagunas significativas en la rica historia del partido sin abordar y ha permitido la perpetuación de inexactitudes y percepciones erróneas con respecto a su pasado. Dada esta y la pertinencia constante del partido en el Líbano y Siria, es aún más necesario examinar a fondo la historia temprana de la SSNP, la organización política y el movimiento que encarnaron la expresión más explícita y convincente del nacionalismo sirio.

Basándose en un examen amplio y exhaustivo de fuentes primarias en árabe, francés e inglés, la monografía es la primera historia integral y sistemática de la SSNP hasta la fecha, detallando su lucha por cumplir su visión nacionalista y establecer un estado secular e independiente en Gran Siria mediante un análisis exhaustivo de su formación, evolución y actividades políticas en Líbano y Siria.

title: How Innovative Partnerships Are Changing Health Care Delivery
description: Innovation is transforming the health care industry, with unlikely collaborators teaming up to provide higher-quality, lower-cost services. In this interview with MIT SMR, Harvard Business School professor Regina Herzlinger, an expert in health care delivery and innovation, discusses recent collaborations between retailers and insurers, such as CVS’s partnership with Aetna and Walmart’s with Humana, and explains why hospitals and other providers must be more innovative, too.

En esta entrevista con MIT SMR, la profesora de Harvard Business School, Regina Herzlinger, experta en atención médica e innovación, discute recientes colaboraciones entre minoristas e aseguradoras, como la asociación de CVS con Aetna y Walmart con Humana, y explica por qué los hospitales y otros proveedores deben ser más innovadores, también.

title: The Inventor of Stereo
description:
This book is the definitive study of the life and works of one of Britain's most important inventors who, due to a cruel set of circumstances, has all but been overlooked by history.

Alan Dower Blumlein led an extraordinary life in which his inventive output rate easily surpassed that of Edison, but whose early death during the darkest days of World War Two led to a shroud of secrecy which has covered his life and achievements ever since.

His 1931 Patent for a Binaural Recording system was so revolutionary that most of his contemporaries regarded it at as more than 20 years ahead of its time. Even years after his death, the full magnitude of its detail had not been fully utilized. Among his 128 Patents are the principle electronic circuits critical to the development of the world's first electronic television system. During his short working life, Blumlein produced patent after patent breaking entirely new ground in electronic and audio engineering.

During the Second World War, Alan Blumlein was deeply engaged in the very secret work of radar development and contributed enormously to the system eventually to become 'H2S'- blind bombing radar. Tragically, during an experimental H2S flight in June 1942, the Halifax bomber in which Blumlein and several colleagues were flying, crashed and all aboard were killed. He was just days short of his 39th birthday.

For many years there have been rumours about a biography of Alan Blumlein, yet none has been forthcoming. This is the world's first study of a man whose achievements should rank among those of the greatest Britain has produced. This book provides detailed knowledge of every one of his patents and the process behind them, while giving an in depth study of the life and times of this quite extraordinary man.

Su patente de 1931 para un sistema de grabación binaural fue tan revolucionario que la mayoría de sus contemporáneos lo consideraban más de 20 años antes de su época. Incluso años después de su muerte, la magnitud total de su detalle no se había utilizado plenamente. Entre sus 128 patentes están los principales circuitos electrónicos críticos para el desarrollo del primer sistema de televisión electrónica del mundo. Durante su corta vida laboral, Blumlein produjo patente después de la ruptura de patentes totalmente nueva en ingeniería electrónica y audio.

Durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, Alan Blumlein estuvo profundamente involucrado en el trabajo muy secreto del desarrollo de radar y contribuyó enormemente al sistema para convertirse en un radar de bombardeo ciego 'H2S'. Tragically, during an experimental H2S flight in June 1942, the Halifax bomber in which Blumlein and several colleagues were flying, crashed and all aboard were killed. Estaba a pocos días de su 39 cumpleaños.

Durante muchos años ha habido rumores sobre una biografía de Alan Blumlein, sin embargo ninguno ha sido próximo. Este es el primer estudio mundial de un hombre cuyos logros deben clasificarse entre los más grandes de Gran Bretaña. Este libro proporciona conocimiento detallado de cada una de sus patentes y el proceso detrás de ellas, al tiempo que da un estudio profundo de la vida y tiempos de este hombre bastante extraordinario.

title: Mastering ROS 2 for Robotics Programming - Fourth Edition
description:
Dive into robotics with "Mastering ROS 2 for Robotics Programming," a comprehensive guide designed to help you harness the full power of ROS 2. Whether you're a newcomer or experienced developer in the field, this book takes you from foundational concepts to advanced topics like real-world robot applications and integrating machine learning with ROS 2.

What this Book will help me do

Understand and master the ROS 2 architecture, core components, and tools for robotics
Simulate and model robots in realistic environments using Gazebo and ROS 2
Develop autonomous robots with navigation and manipulation capabilities using Nav2 and MoveIt 2 in ROS 2
Apply advanced AI concepts, such as LLM-based intelligent planning and reinforcement learning, in robotics
Design and build real-world robotic systems, including a DIY mobile robot, with ROS 2 and Raspberry Pi

Author(s)

Lentin Joseph, co-founder of RUNTIME Robotics, and Jonathan Cacace, a PhD in robotics with extensive experience in the field, bring you this authoritative guide. Their expertise spans robotics research and practical applications, making this book an invaluable resource. They employ a hands-on approach to teaching complex concepts, ensuring readers grasp both theory and practical skills.

title: The Hardware Hacking Handbook
description:
Embedded devices are chip-size microcomputers small enough to be included in the structure of the object they control, and they’re everywhere—in phones, cars, credit cards, laptops, medical equipment, even critical infrastructure. This means understanding their security is critical. The Hardware Hacking Handbook takes you deep inside different types of embedded systems, revealing the designs, components, security limits, and reverse-engineering challenges you need to know for executing effective hardware attacks.

Written with wit and infused with hands-on lab experiments, this handbook puts you in the role of an attacker interested in breaking security to do good. Starting with a crash course on the architecture of embedded devices, threat modeling, and attack trees, you’ll go on to explore hardware interfaces, ports and communication protocols, electrical signaling, tips for analyzing firmware images, and more. Along the way, you’ll use a home testing lab to perform fault-injection, side-channel (SCA), and simple and differential power analysis (SPA/DPA) attacks on a variety of real devices, such as a crypto wallet. The authors also share insights into real-life attacks on embedded systems, including Sony’s PlayStation 3, the Xbox 360, and Philips Hue lights, and provide an appendix of the equipment needed for your hardware hacking lab – like a multimeter and an oscilloscope – with options for every type of budget.

You’ll learn:

•How to model security threats, using attacker profiles, assets, objectives, and countermeasures•Electrical basics that will help you understand communication interfaces, signaling, and measurement•How to identify injection points for executing clock, voltage, electromagnetic, laser, and body-biasing fault attacks, as well as practical injection tips•How to use timing and power analysis attacks to extract passwords and cryptographic keys•Techniques for leveling up both simple and differential power analysis, from practical measurement tips to filtering, processing, and visualization

Whether you’re an industry engineer tasked with understanding these attacks, a student starting out in the field, or an electronics hobbyist curious about replicating existing work, The Hardware Hacking Handbook is an indispensable resource – one you’ll always want to have onhand.

Esto significa entender que su seguridad es crítica. El Hardware Hacking Handbook te lleva dentro de diferentes tipos de sistemas integrados, revelando los diseños, componentes, límites de seguridad y desafíos de ingeniería inversa que necesitas saber para ejecutar ataques de hardware eficaces.

title: Introduction to Wireless System Design
description:
Technical insights on the vital aspects of hardware and software components in modern wireless system design

Introduction to Wireless System Design: From Circuits to Web-based Applications provides an introductory level overview for readers to acquire technical insights on the most important aspects of modern wireless system design from an industrial and practical perspective.

Various functional blocks of wireless systems and products are discussed and analyzed with practical examples of commercial products. Software development is addressed to provide a comprehensive understanding of the development of complete wireless systems. The book concludes by presenting practical design examples followed by future trends.

Core topics covered in this book include wireless standards for GPS, Bluetooth, cellular, Wi-Fi, Zigbee, LoRaWAN, Sigfox, and NBIoT; major transmitter issues including power gain, power efficiency, harmonic prevention, and suppression; and server software development for building dynamic web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Written by three highly qualified authors, the book also includes information on:

System characteristics of hardware receivers, including noise temperature, bandwidth, figure, and sensitivity
Components of circuit blocks in hardware transmitters, including oscillator, modulator, buffer amplifier, frequency multiplier, power amplifier, output filter
Types of antennas, including dipole, monopole, loop, beam-forming, and miniature designs like patch, inverted-L, inverted-F, and meandered line
Elements of software architecture design, including user interface, data and sequence flow, and timing diagrams
Smartphone application software development, with insight on tools such as Android Studio, Flutter, React, and Swift

Introduction to Wireless System Design: From Circuits to Web-based Applications is a highly practical and actionable resource on the subject for practicing engineers and programmers, as well as graduate and undergraduate students in related programs of study.

title: Communication Systems Engineering with GNU Radio
description:
An approachable guide to an invaluable radio frequency communication toolkit

Software-defined radio (SDR), which emerged in the 1990s, has become a core development method in certain high-profile fields, including military and space communications. High cost and problems with hardware availability, however, prevented this technology from being widely disseminated. The advent of low-cost hardware beginning in the 2010s, however, has made GNU Radio—the leading open-source software toolkit for developing SDR systems—an increasingly viable and even critical tool for a new generation of radio frequency communication engineers.

Communication Systems Engineering with GNU Radio provides an accessible overview of this toolkit and its applications. Beginning with the fundamentals of using GNU radio for digital signal processing, the volume then moves to the practicalities of decoding data and the advantages of accessing raw data normally unavailable in hardware-defined radio frequency receivers. The result is a potentially crucial tool for engineers looking to adopt this cost-effective and flexible standard for transmitting and processing radio frequency signals.

Readers will also find:

A careful balance of radio communications theory with GNU Radio practicalities
Practical implementation examples employing well-developed open-source GNU Radio platforms
Extensive accompanying documentation and explanation

Communication Systems Engineering with GNU Radio is ideal for graduate and undergraduate students in communications systems courses, as well as professionals working in SDR.

Una guía accesible para un kit de herramientas de comunicación de frecuencia de radio invaluable

La radio definida por software (SDR), que surgió en el decenio de 1990, se ha convertido en un método básico de desarrollo en ciertos campos de alto perfil, incluidas las comunicaciones militares y espaciales. Sin embargo, los altos costos y los problemas con la disponibilidad de hardware impidieron que esta tecnología se difundiera ampliamente. Sin embargo, el advenimiento de hardware de bajo costo a partir de los años 2010 ha hecho de GNU Radio —el principal conjunto de herramientas de software de código abierto para el desarrollo de sistemas SDR— una herramienta cada vez más viable e incluso crítica para una nueva generación de ingenieros de comunicación de radiofrecuencia.

Ingeniería de Sistemas de Comunicación con Radio GNU proporciona una visión general accesible de este kit de herramientas y sus aplicaciones. Comenzando con los fundamentos del uso de la radio GNU para el procesamiento digital de señales, el volumen luego se mueve a las prácticas de decodificación de datos y las ventajas de acceder a datos brutos normalmente no disponibles en los receptores de frecuencias de radio definidas por hardware. El resultado es una herramienta potencialmente crucial para los ingenieros que buscan adoptar este estándar rentable y flexible para transmitir y procesar señales de frecuencia de radio.

Un equilibrio cuidadoso de la teoría de las comunicaciones radiofónicas con las prácticas de Radio GNU
Ejemplos prácticos de implementación que emplean plataformas de radio GNU de código abierto bien desarrolladas
Extensiva documentación y explicación adjunta

Ingeniería de Sistemas de Comunicación con Radio GNU es ideal para estudiantes de posgrado y licenciatura en cursos de sistemas de comunicaciones, así como profesionales que trabajan en RDA.

IoT Fundamentals brings together knowledge previously available only in white papers, standards documents, and other hard-to-find sources—or nowhere at all. The authors begin with a high-level overview of IoT and introduce key concepts needed to successfully design IoT solutions. Next, they walk through each key technology, protocol, and technical building block that combine into complete IoT solutions. Building on these essentials, they present several detailed use cases, including manufacturing, energy, utilities, smart+connected cities, transportation, mining, and public safety. Whatever your role or existing infrastructure, you’ll gain deep insight what IoT applications can do, and what it takes to deliver them.

Fully covers the principles and components of next-generation wireless networks built with Cisco IOT solutions such as IEEE 802.11 (Wi-Fi), IEEE 802.15.4-2015 (Mesh), and LoRaWAN

Brings together real-world tips, insights, and best practices for designing and implementing next-generation wireless networks

Reflects the extensive first-hand experience of Cisco experts

title: Engineering Secure Devices
description:
"

As an engineer, you know that countless devices—from industrial components to smart household appliances—rely on embedded computer systems. But how do you balance the need for robust security with performance and innovative product design?

Engineering Secure Devices will guide you through crafting secure devices—from protecting crucial assets to the nature of attackers and the risks they pose. You’ll explore the technical intricacies and pros and cons of symmetric and asymmetric cryptography and learn how to use and analyze random number generators and cryptographic algorithms. You’ll learn how to ensure confidential data storage and secure memory, and devise secure device identity solutions and communication protocols to reinforce system architecture against potential threats. And finally, you’ll learn how to properly design secure boot and secure update processes, manage access control, and perform system monitoring to secure IoT devices.

Real-world case studies throughout highlight practical applications, solutions, and obstacles, such as firmware updates with SWUpdate, secure communication with MQTT, and advanced access control with AppArmor.

You’ll also dig into topics like:

Analyzing the performance of cryptographic implementations in both hardware and software
Considerations for secure boot and software update processes to ensure ongoing firmware integrity
Designing robust device architectures that withstand attacks while maintaining critical operations
Developing strategies to detect and respond to anomalies or security breaches in embedded systems

Whether you’re an IoT developer or an embedded system architect, Engineering Secure Devices equips you with the indispensable knowledge to design, secure, and support the next generation of smart devices—from webcams to four-legged robots.

"
translatedDescription:
"

Como ingeniero, usted sabe que innumerables dispositivos —desde componentes industriales hasta electrodomésticos inteligentes— se encuentran en sistemas informáticos integrados. Pero ¿cómo equilibra la necesidad de una seguridad robusta con rendimiento y diseño innovador de productos?

Engineering Secure Devices le guiará mediante la creación de dispositivos seguros, desde la protección de activos cruciales hasta la naturaleza de los atacantes y los riesgos que plantean. Explorará las complejidades técnicas y los pros y contras de criptografía simétrica y asimétrica y aprenderá a utilizar y analizar generadores de números aleatorios y algoritmos criptográficos. Aprenderá a garantizar el almacenamiento confidencial de datos y la memoria segura, y diseñará soluciones seguras de identidad de dispositivos y protocolos de comunicación para reforzar la arquitectura del sistema contra amenazas potenciales. Y por último, aprenderá a diseñar correctamente procesos de arranque seguros y de actualización seguros, gestionar el control de acceso y realizar el monitoreo del sistema para asegurar dispositivos IoT.

Estudios de casos reales a lo largo de aplicaciones prácticas, soluciones y obstáculos destacados, como actualizaciones de firmware con SWUpdate, comunicación segura con MQTT y control de acceso avanzado con AppArmor.

También investigará temas como:

Analizar el desempeño de implementaciones criptográficas tanto en hardware como en software
Consideraciones para procesos seguros de actualización de botas y software para garantizar la integridad de firmware en curso
Diseño de arquitecturas de dispositivos robustas que resisten ataques manteniendo operaciones críticas
Elaboración de estrategias para detectar y responder a anomalías o infracciones de seguridad en los sistemas integrados

Ya sea que usted es un desarrollador de IoT o un arquitecto de sistema integrado, Engineering Secure Devices le proporciona el conocimiento indispensable para diseñar, asegurar y apoyar la próxima generación de dispositivos inteligentes, desde webcams a robots de cuatro patas.

"

title: Open Circuits
description:
Open Circuits is a photographic exploration of the beautiful design inside everyday electronics. Its stunning cross-section photography unlocks a hidden world full of elegance, subtle complexity, and wonder.

Our phones, computers, and appliances are made of hundreds of internal components, each precisely engineered to perform a certain function, but none intended to actually be seen. Through painstakingly executed, vividly detailed cross-section photography, Open Circuits reveals the surprising—and often accidental—beauty hiding inside the electronic components that drive our everyday devices.

From resistors to LEDs, USB cables to headphone jacks, stepper motors to nixie tubes, the book’s arresting imagery transforms more than 130 components into delightful works of art. As you visually dissect the components’ insides, you’ll learn about how they work and how they were made. Open Circuits has something for everyone to appreciate, whether you’re a seasoned electrical engineer, an amateur tinkerer, or simply a lover of art and photography.
translatedDescription:
Open Circuits es una exploración fotográfica del hermoso diseño dentro de la electrónica cotidiana. Su impresionante fotografía transversal desbloquea un mundo oculto lleno de elegancia, complejidad sutil y maravilla.

Nuestros teléfonos, computadoras y electrodomésticos están hechos de cientos de componentes internos, cada uno diseñado precisamente para realizar una determinada función, pero ninguno destinado a ser visto. A través de la fotografía de sección transversal cuidadosamente ejecutada, vívidamente detallada, Open Circuits revela la sorprendente y a menudo accidental belleza escondida dentro de los componentes electrónicos que conducen nuestros dispositivos cotidianos.

De resistores a LEDs, cables USB a conectores de auriculares, motores de paso a tubos de nixie, la imagen de captura del libro transforma más de 130 componentes en obras de arte encantadoras. Al diseccionar visualmente el interior de los componentes, usted aprenderá sobre cómo funcionan y cómo se hicieron. Open Circuits tiene algo para que todo el mundo pueda apreciar, ya sea un ingeniero eléctrico experimentado, un tinkerer amateur, o simplemente un amante del arte y la fotografía.

title: Preventing Bluetooth and Wireless Attacks in IoMT Healthcare Systems
description:
A timely technical guide to securing network-connected medical devices

In Preventing Bluetooth and Wireless Attacks in IoMT Healthcare Systems, Principal Security Architect for Connection, John Chirillo, delivers a robust and up-to-date discussion of securing network-connected medical devices. The author walks you through available attack vectors, detection and prevention strategies, probable future trends, emerging threats, and legal, regulatory, and ethical considerations that will frequently arise for practitioners working in the area.

Following an introduction to the field of Internet of Medical Things devices and their recent evolution, the book provides a detailed and technical series of discussions—including common real-world scenarios, examples, and case studies—on how to prevent both common and unusual attacks against these devices.

Inside the book:

Techniques for using recently created tools, including new encryption methods and artificial intelligence, to safeguard healthcare technology
Explorations of how the rise of quantum computing, 5G, and other new or emerging technology might impact medical device security
Examinations of sophisticated techniques used by bad actors to exploit vulnerabilities on Bluetooth and other wireless networks

Perfect for cybersecurity professionals, IT specialists in healthcare environments, and IT, cybersecurity, or medical researchers with an interest in protecting sensitive personal data and critical medical infrastructure, Preventing Bluetooth and Wireless Attacks in IoMT Healthcare Systems is a timely and comprehensive guide to securing medical devices.

El autor le acompaña a través de vectores de ataque disponibles, estrategias de detección y prevención, probables tendencias futuras, amenazas emergentes, y consideraciones legales, reglamentarias y éticas que a menudo surgirán para los profesionales que trabajan en la zona.

Tras una introducción al campo de los dispositivos de Internet de las cosas médicas y su evolución reciente, el libro ofrece una serie detallada y técnica de discusiones, incluyendo escenarios comunes del mundo real, ejemplos y estudios de casos, sobre cómo prevenir ataques comunes e inusuales contra estos dispositivos.

Exámenes de técnicas sofisticadas utilizadas por actores malos para explotar vulnerabilidades en redes Bluetooth y otras redes inalámbricas

title: Greek and Roman Slaveries
description:
Greek and Roman Slaveries

Slavery was foundational to Greek and Roman societies, affecting nearly all of their economic, social, political, and cultural practices. Greek and Roman Slaveries offers a rich collection of literary, epigraphic, papyrological, and archaeological sources, including many unfamiliar ones. This sourcebook ranges chronologically from the archaic period to late antiquity, covering the whole of the Mediterranean, the Near East, and temperate Europe.

Readers will find an interactive and user-friendly engagement with past scholarship and new research agendas that focuses particularly on the agency of ancient slaves, the processes in which slavery was inscribed, the changing history of slavery in antiquity, and the comparative study of ancient slaveries.

Perfect for undergraduate and graduate students taking courses on ancient slavery, as well as courses on slavery more generally, this sourcebook’s questions, cross-references, and bibliographies encourage an analytical and interactive approach to the various economic, social, and political processes and contexts in which slavery was employed while acknowledging the agency of enslaved persons.
translatedDescription:
Eslavos griegos y romanos

La esclavitud es fundamental para las sociedades griega y romana, afectando casi todas sus prácticas económicas, sociales, políticas y culturales. Eslavos griegos y romanos ofrece una rica colección de fuentes literarias, epigráficas, papirológicas y arqueológicas, incluyendo muchas desconocidas. Este libro de fuentes va cronológicamente desde el período arcaico hasta la antigüedad tardía, cubriendo todo el Mediterráneo, el Cercano Oriente y Europa templada.

Los lectores encontrarán un compromiso interactivo y fácil de usar con becas pasadas y nuevas agendas de investigación que se centran especialmente en la agencia de esclavos antiguos, los procesos en los que se inscribió la esclavitud, la historia cambiante de la esclavitud en la antigüedad, y el estudio comparativo de antiguas esclavitudes.

Perfecto para estudiantes de pregrado y graduados que toman cursos sobre la esclavitud antigua, así como cursos sobre la esclavitud en general, las preguntas de este libro de fuentes, las referencias cruzadas y las bibliografías fomentan un enfoque analítico e interactivo de los diversos procesos y contextos económicos, sociales y políticos en los que se empleó la esclavitud reconociendo la agencia de personas esclavizadas.

Readers should be familiar with the basics of RPA tools, processes, and documentation such as Solution Design Documents (SDD) and Process Design Documents (PDD), but prior extensive experience is not a prerequisite.

title: Food Engineering Automation with Robotics and AI
description:
Revolutionize food manufacturing with the latest in automating technology

Virtually every area of industry has been transformed by robotics and AI, which have automated production and increased efficiency in myriad ways. Until recently, food manufacturing was an exception to the trend. At present, however, the food manufacturing industry is in the process of a transformation which will see automation deliver the same levels of productivity and uniformity that have revolutionized other sectors of the economy.

Food Engineering Automation with Robotics and AI is a comprehensive introduction to the areas of intersection between cutting-edge technologies and food manufacturing. Beginning with an overview of the basic principles of food engineering, the book then details applications of robotics and AI in this field, along with the way automation is integrated at every stage of food production. The structure of the book seamlessly blends theory and practice to maximize reader capacity to put its lessons into motion.

Food Engineering Automation with Robotics and AI readers will also find:

Content aligning with several UN Sustainable Development Goals, including Zero Hunger; Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure; and Responsible Consumption and Production
Real-world case studies throughout to show automating technologies revolutionizing food production
A consistent focus on sustainable food engineering, with attention to resource conservation, waste reduction, environmental impact mitigation, and more

Food Engineering Automation with Robotics and AI is ideal for the growing, global market for food automation technologies in the coming years.

Hasta hace poco, la fabricación de alimentos era una excepción a la tendencia. En la actualidad, sin embargo, la industria manufacturera de alimentos está en proceso de transformación que permitirá que la automatización proporcione los mismos niveles de productividad y uniformidad que han revolucionado otros sectores de la economía.

Food Engineering Automation with Robotics and AI is a comprehensive introduction to the areas of intersection between cut-edge technologies and food manufacturing. Comenzando con una visión general de los principios básicos de la ingeniería alimentaria, el libro detalla las aplicaciones de la robótica y la IA en este campo, junto con la forma en que la automatización se integra en cada etapa de la producción de alimentos. Contenido alineado con varios Objetivos de Desarrollo Sostenible de las Naciones Unidas, incluyendo Hambre Cero; Industria, Innovación e Infraestructura; y Consumo y Producción Responsables
Estudios de casos del mundo real para mostrar tecnologías automatizadas revolucionando la producción de alimentos
Un enfoque constante en la ingeniería alimentaria sostenible, con atención a la conservación de los recursos, la reducción de los desechos, la mitigación de los efectos ambientales y más

Food Engineering Automation with Robotics and AI es ideal para el creciente mercado mundial de tecnologías de automatización de alimentos en los próximos años.

title: Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare
description:
Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Healthcare is more than a comprehensive introduction to artificial intelligence as a tool in the generation and analysis of healthcare data. The book is split into two sections where the first section describes the current healthcare challenges　and the rise of AI in this arena. The ten following chapters are written by specialists in each area, covering the whole healthcare ecosystem. First, the AI applications in drug design and drug development are presented followed by its applications in the field of cancer diagnostics, treatment and medical imaging. Subsequently, the application of AI in medical devices and surgery are covered as well as remote patient monitoring. Finally, the book dives into the topics of security, privacy, information sharing, health insurances and legal aspects of AI in healthcare.

Highlights different data techniques in healthcare data analysis, including machine learning and data mining
Illustrates different applications and challenges across the design, implementation and management of intelligent systems and healthcare data networks
Includes applications and case studies across all areas of AI in healthcare data

Inteligencia Artificial (AI) en Saludcare es más que una introducción integral a la inteligencia artificial como herramienta en la generación y análisis de datos sanitarios. El libro se divide en dos secciones donde la primera sección describe los desafíos actuales de la salud y el aumento de la IA en esta arena. Los diez capítulos siguientes son escritos por especialistas en cada área, cubriendo todo el ecosistema sanitario. En primer lugar, las aplicaciones de IA en el diseño de drogas y el desarrollo de drogas se presentan seguidas de sus aplicaciones en el campo del diagnóstico de cáncer, tratamiento e imágenes médicas. Posteriormente, la aplicación de la IA en dispositivos médicos y cirugía está cubierta, así como el control remoto del paciente. Por último, el libro se sumerge en los temas de seguridad, privacidad, intercambio de información, seguros de salud y aspectos legales de AI en salud.

Destaca diferentes técnicas de datos en el análisis de datos sanitarios, incluyendo el aprendizaje automático y la extracción de datos
Ilustra diferentes aplicaciones y desafíos en el diseño, implementación y gestión de sistemas inteligentes y redes de datos sanitarios
Incluye aplicaciones y estudios de casos en todas las áreas de IA en datos sanitarios

title: Hands-On Industrial Internet of Things - Second Edition
description:
Delve into the exciting domain of the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) with this comprehensive guide. "Hands-On Industrial Internet of Things" equips readers with cutting-edge knowledge to harness IoT, cloud, and AI technologies effectively for industrial applications. You will learn to build reliable IIoT infrastructure, leveraging AWS, Azure, and open-source tools to handle real-world challenges.

What this Book will help me do

Gain a deep understanding of the foundational principles underpinning the Industrial Internet of Things.
Learn to design and implement IIoT architectures that use cloud platforms like AWS and Azure effectively.
Master the application of diagnostic analytics and predictive analytics for better decision-making on the shop floor.
Explore edge and fog computing, and learn to deploy robust IIoT solutions leveraging advanced protocols like OPC UA and MQTT.
Get hands-on with creating digital twins using state-of-the-art tools and computational models, enhancing operational effectiveness.

Author(s)

Giacomo Veneri and Antonio Capasso are seasoned experts in IoT and artificial intelligence technologies, with extensive experience in designing and delivering industrial solutions. Together, they bring a practical yet visionary approach to teaching, blending deep technical knowledge with real-world applications to guide readers step by step through the complexities of IIoT.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for IT professionals, such as IoT system architects, developers, and AI engineers, who are interested in designing effective IIoT-based architecture and solutions. It caters to readers with a foundational understanding of Python and networking and who aspire to master IIoT technologies and applications for professional or organizational improvement.
translatedDescription:
Incluya en el emocionante dominio de Internet Industrial de las Cosas (IIoT) con esta guía integral. "Hands-On Industrial Internet of Things" equipa a los lectores con conocimientos de vanguardia para aprovechar las tecnologías IoT, cloud y AI eficazmente para aplicaciones industriales. Aprenderás a construir una infraestructura fiable de IIoT, aprovechando las herramientas AWS, Azure y de código abierto para manejar los desafíos del mundo real.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Comprender profundamente los principios fundamentales que sustentan la Internet Industrial de las Cosas.
Aprende a diseñar e implementar arquitecturas IIoT que utilizan plataformas de nube como AWS y Azure eficazmente.
Domine la aplicación de analítica diagnóstica y analítica predictiva para una mejor toma de decisiones en el piso de la tienda.
Explore la computación de filo y niebla, y aprenda a implementar soluciones robustas de IIoT aprovechando protocolos avanzados como OPC UA y MQTT.
Obtenga mano a mano con la creación de gemelos digitales utilizando herramientas de última generación y modelos computacionales, mejorando la eficacia operativa.

Autor(s)

Giacomo Veneri y Antonio Capasso son expertos experimentados en IoT y tecnologías de inteligencia artificial, con amplia experiencia en diseño y entrega de soluciones industriales. Juntos, aportan un enfoque práctico pero visionario a la enseñanza, mezclando conocimientos técnicos profundos con aplicaciones reales para guiar a los lectores paso a paso por las complejidades de IIoT.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para profesionales de TI, como arquitectos del sistema IoT, desarrolladores e ingenieros de IA, que están interesados en diseñar arquitectura y soluciones efectivas basadas en IIoT. Se dirige a los lectores con una comprensión fundamental de Python y networking y que aspiran a dominar las tecnologías y aplicaciones IIoT para la mejora profesional o organizativa.

title: Ham Radio For Dummies, 4th Edition
description:
Respond to the call of ham radio 

Despite its old-school reputation, amateur radio is on the rise, and the airwaves are busier than ever. That’s no surprise: being a ham is a lot of fun, providing an independent way to keep in touch with friends, family, and new acquaintances around the world—and even beyond with its ability to connect with the International Space Station! Hams are also good in a crisis, keeping communications alive and crackling during extreme weather events and loss of communications until regular systems like cell phones and the internet are restored. Additionally, it’s enjoyable for good, old-fashioned tech geek reasons—fiddling with circuits and bouncing signals off the ionosphere just happens to give a lot of us a buzz!   

If one or more of these benefits is of interest to you, then good news: the new edition of Ham Radio For Dummies covers them all! In his signature friendly style, longtime ham Ward Silver (Call Sign NØAX)—contributing editor with the American Radio Relay League—patches you in on everything from getting the right equipment and building your station (it doesn’t have to be expensive) to the intricacies of Morse code and Ohm’s law. In addition, he coaches you on how to prepare for the FCC-mandated licensing exam and tunes you up for ultimate glory in the ham radio hall of fame as a Radiosport competitor! With this book, you’ll learn to: 

Set up and organize your station 
Communicate with people around the world 
Prep for and pass the FCC exam 
Tune into the latest tech, such as digital mode operating  

Whether you’re looking to join a public service club or want the latest tips on the cutting edge of ham technology, this is the perfect reference for newbies and experts alike—and will keep you happily hamming it up for years!
translatedDescription:
Responder a la llamada de radio de jamón

A pesar de su reputación en la vieja escuela, la radio amateur está en aumento, y las ondas de aire son más bulliciosas que nunca. Eso no es una sorpresa: ser un jamón es muy divertido, proporcionando una manera independiente de mantenerse en contacto con amigos, familiares y nuevos conocidos en todo el mundo, e incluso más allá de su capacidad de conectarse con la Estación Espacial Internacional! Los jamones también son buenos en una crisis, manteniendo las comunicaciones vivas y crujientes durante eventos meteorológicos extremos y la pérdida de comunicaciones hasta que se restablezcan sistemas regulares como teléfonos celulares y internet. Además, es agradable por buenas y viejas razones de la tecnología geek: ¡rellenar con circuitos y rebotar señales de la ionosfera nos da un zumbido!

Si uno o más de estos beneficios es de interés para usted, entonces buenas noticias: la nueva edición de Ham Radio For Dummies los cubre todos! En su estilo amigable con la firma, el jamón Ward Silver (Call Sign NØAX) —redactor con la American Radio Relay League— le da cabida en todo para conseguir el equipo adecuado y construir su estación (no tiene que ser caro) a las complejidades del código Morse y la ley de Ohm. Además, él le entrena sobre cómo prepararse para el examen de licencias de FCC y le afina para la gloria máxima en la sala de radio de jamón de fama como competidor de Radiosport! Con este libro aprenderás a:

Configurar y organizar su estación
Comunicarse con personas de todo el mundo
Preparar y pasar el examen de FCC
Tune en la última tecnología, como el modo digital operativo

Ya sea que usted está buscando unirse a un club de servicio público o desear los últimos consejos en el borde de vanguardia de la tecnología de jamón, esta es la referencia perfecta para los novatos y expertos por igual - y te mantendrá feliz adelgazándolo durante años!

title: Real World Haskell
description: This easy-to-use, fast-moving tutorial introduces you to functional programming with Haskell. You'll learn how to use Haskell in a variety of practical ways, from short scripts to large and demanding applications. Real World Haskell takes you through the basics of functional programming at a brisk pace, and then helps you increase your understanding of Haskell in real-world issues like I/O, performance, dealing with data, concurrency, and more as you move through each chapter.
translatedDescription: Este tutorial fácil de usar y rápido te presenta a la programación funcional con Haskell. Aprenderás a usar Haskell de diversas maneras prácticas, desde scripts cortos hasta aplicaciones grandes y exigentes. Real World Haskell te lleva a través de los fundamentos de la programación funcional a un ritmo de riesgo, y luego te ayuda a aumentar tu comprensión de Haskell en temas del mundo real como I/O, rendimiento, tratamiento de datos, concurrencia y más a medida que avanzas a través de cada capítulo.

title: Wireless Communications Principles and Practice, Second Edition
description:
The indispensable guide to wireless communications—now fully revised and updated!

Wireless Communications: Principles and Practice, Second Edition is the definitive modern text for wireless communications technology and system design. Building on his classic first edition, Theodore S. Rappaport covers the fundamental issues impacting all wireless networks and reviews virtually every important new wireless standard and technological development, offering especially comprehensive coverage of the 3G systems and wireless local area networks (WLANs) that will transform communications in the coming years. Rappaport illustrates each key concept with practical examples, thoroughly explained and solved step by step. Coverage includes:

An overview of key wireless technologies: voice, data, cordless, paging, fixed and mobile broadband wireless systems, and beyond

Wireless system design fundamentals: channel assignment, handoffs, trunking efficiency, interference, frequency reuse, capacity planning, large-scale fading, and more

Path loss, small-scale fading, multipath, reflection, diffraction, scattering, shadowing, spatial-temporal channel modeling, and microcell/indoor propagation

Modulation, equalization, diversity, channel coding, and speech coding

New wireless LAN technologies: IEEE 802.11a/b, HIPERLAN, BRAN, and other alternatives

New 3G air interface standards, including W-CDMA, cdma2000, GPRS, UMTS, and EDGE

Bluetooth wearable computers, fixed wireless and Local Multipoint Distribution Service (LMDS), and other advanced technologies

Updated glossary of abbreviations and acronyms, and a thorough list of references

Dozens of new examples and end-of-chapter problems

Whether you're a communications/network professional, manager, researcher, or student, Wireless Communications: Principles and Practice, Second Edition gives you an in-depth understanding of the state of the art in wireless technology—today's and tomorrow's.
translatedDescription:
¡La guía indispensable para las comunicaciones inalámbricas, ahora completamente revisada y actualizada!

Comunicaciones inalámbricas: Principios y prácticas, Second Edition es el texto moderno definitivo para la tecnología de comunicaciones inalámbricas y el diseño del sistema. Sobre la base de su primera edición clásica, Theodore S. Rappaport cubre los temas fundamentales que afectan a todas las redes inalámbricas y revisa prácticamente todos los nuevos estándares inalámbricos y desarrollo tecnológico, ofreciendo una cobertura especialmente amplia de los sistemas 3G y redes de área local inalámbrica (WLANs) que transformarán las comunicaciones en los próximos años. Rappaport ilustra cada concepto clave con ejemplos prácticos, explicado y resuelto paso a paso. La cobertura incluye:

Una visión general de las tecnologías inalámbricas clave: sistemas inalámbricos de voz, datos, sin cables, paging, fijos y móviles de banda ancha, y más allá

Fundamentos de diseño de sistemas inalámbricos: asignación de canales, desvíos, eficiencia de troncales, interferencia, reutilización de frecuencias, planificación de capacidades, descoloración a gran escala y más

Pérdida de caminos, fading en pequeña escala, multipático, reflexión, difracción, dispersión, sombra, modelado de canales espaciales-temporales, y propagación de microcréditos / interiores

Modulación, igualdad, diversidad, codificación de canales y codificación de discursos

Nuevas tecnologías LAN inalámbricas: IEEE 802.11a/b, HIPERLAN, BRAN y otras alternativas

Nuevos estándares de interfaz de aire 3G, incluyendo W-CDMA, cdma2000, GPRS, UMTS y EDGE

Computadoras portátiles Bluetooth, servicio fijo de distribución inalámbrica y local multipunto (LMDS), y otras tecnologías avanzadas

Glosario actualizado de abreviaturas y siglas, y una lista completa de referencias

Docenas de nuevos ejemplos y problemas de final de capítulo

Ya sea profesional de comunicaciones/redes, gerente, investigador o estudiante, Comunicaciones inalámbricas: Principios y práctica, Segunda edición le da una comprensión profunda del estado del arte en la tecnología inalámbrica, hoy y mañana.

title: Becoming the Change: Leadership Behavior Strategies for Continuous Improvement in Healthcare
description:
Two renowned experts in healthcare transformation show how leaders are implementing behavior-driven strategies to ensure quality care and create lasting change.

Healthcare is in the midst of a massive disruption. With financial structures in tatters and the future uncertain, this is the moment to begin the revolution. But first, leaders need to learn how to support staff at all levels as they make transformational improvements in care. This book demonstrates that real change is very personal and has to start at the top―whether you’re an executive, governing board member, manager, or physician.

A powerful new approach to healthcare leadership, this book showcases executives in health systems around the world as they:

Practice behavior-based solutions to organizational problems
Learn how to support continuous improvement
Be more present in their leadership role
Learn how to reflect and assess themselves as leaders
Achieve better results for patients

Drawing on a wealth of behavioral research, industry case studies, and personal insights from healthcare professionals, the authors explore how change actually happens—from the inside out, top to bottom, throughout the whole organization. You’ll learn how healthcare systems led by people who are compassionate, principled, and engaged can undergo profound and lasting transformation. Find proven strategies for cultivating principle-driven behaviors that can turn the remotest possibilities on the healthcare horizon into a new working reality.

This is more than a leadership guide to revolutionizing healthcare. This is about being a force for change that makes life better for patients, caregivers, and all stakeholders. If you want to take the lead in making change happen, start with Becoming the Change.
translatedDescription:
Dos expertos de renombre en la transformación de la salud muestran cómo los líderes están implementando estrategias basadas en el comportamiento para garantizar la atención de calidad y crear cambios duraderos.

El cuidado de la salud está en medio de una perturbación masiva. Con estructuras financieras en tatters y el futuro incierto, este es el momento de comenzar la revolución. Pero primero, los líderes necesitan aprender cómo apoyar al personal a todos los niveles, ya que hacen mejoras de transformación en la atención. Este libro demuestra que el cambio real es muy personal y tiene que comenzar en la parte superior, ya sea un ejecutivo, miembro de la junta directiva, gerente o médico.

Un nuevo enfoque poderoso para el liderazgo sanitario, este libro muestra a ejecutivos en sistemas de salud en todo el mundo como:

Practicar soluciones basadas en el comportamiento para problemas organizativos
Aprende cómo apoyar la mejora continua
Estar más presente en su papel de liderazgo
Aprender a reflexionar y evaluarse como líderes
Lograr mejores resultados para pacientes

Basándose en una gran cantidad de investigación conductual, estudios de casos de la industria y percepciones personales de profesionales de la salud, los autores exploran cómo el cambio realmente sucede, desde el interior, hasta el fondo, en toda la organización. Usted aprenderá cómo los sistemas de salud dirigidos por personas compasivas, de principios y comprometidas pueden sufrir una transformación profunda y duradera. Encuentre estrategias comprobadas para cultivar comportamientos impulsados por principios que puedan convertir las posibilidades más remotas en el horizonte sanitario en una nueva realidad de trabajo.

Esto es más que una guía de liderazgo para revolucionar la salud. Se trata de ser una fuerza para el cambio que hace la vida mejor para los pacientes, cuidadores y todas las partes interesadas. Si quieres tomar la delantera en hacer que ocurra el cambio, empieza con el cambio.

title: Run HashiCorp Vault with Helm
description: Vault is the leading secrets management tool for controlling access to sensitive credentials in low-trust environments and encrypting data in transit. The reader will learn to deploy a production grade vault service, leverage vault roles and policies, and implement data protection strategies.
translatedDescription: Vault es la principal herramienta de gestión de secretos para controlar el acceso a credenciales sensibles en entornos de baja confianza y cifrar datos en tránsito. El lector aprenderá a desplegar un servicio de bóveda de grado de producción, apalancar funciones y políticas de bóveda, e implementar estrategias de protección de datos.

title: Group Communication
description: In this comprehensive, advanced introduction to group communication, the field’s leading experts summarize theory, methodological advancements, and current research in the field.
translatedDescription: En esta introducción amplia y avanzada a la comunicación grupal, los principales expertos del campo resumen la teoría, los avances metodológicos y la investigación actual en el campo.

title: Mental Health and Wellbeing in the Workplace, 2nd Edition
description:
Provides guidance for both employers and staff on promoting positive mental health and supporting those experiencing mental ill health in the workplace

The importance of good mental health and wellbeing in the workplace is a subject of increased public awareness and governmental attention. The Department of Health advises that one in four people will experience a mental health issue at some point in their lives. Although a number of recent developments and initiatives have raised the profile of this crucial issue, employers are experiencing challenges in promoting the mental health and wellbeing of their employees. Mental Health & Wellbeing in the Workplace contains expert guidance for improving mental health and supporting those experiencing mental ill health.

This comprehensive book addresses the range of issues surrounding mental health and wellbeing in work environments – providing all involved with informative and practical assistance. Authors Gill Hasson and Donna Butler examine changing workplace environment for improved wellbeing, shifting employer and employee attitudes on mental health, possible solutions to current and future challenges and more. Detailed, real-world case studies illustrate a variety of associated concerns from both employer and employee perspectives. This important guide:

Explains why understanding mental health is important and its impact on businesses and employees
Discusses why and how to promote mental health in the workplace and the importance of having an effective 'wellbeing strategy'
Provides guidance on managing staff experiencing mental ill health
Addresses dealing with employee stress and anxiety
Features resources for further support if experiencing mental health issues
Introduces the concept of being an ‘active bystander’ and its role in creating a safer and more inclusive workplace environment
Includes up-to-date links to relevant research and websites for further reading and support

Mental Health & Wellbeing in the Workplace, Second Edition is a valuable resource for those in the workplace wanting to look after their physical and mental wellbeing, and those looking for guidance in managing staff with mental health issues.
translatedDescription:
Proporciona orientación tanto para los empleadores como para el personal sobre la promoción de la salud mental positiva y el apoyo a los enfermos mentales en el lugar de trabajo

The importance of good mental health and wellbeing in the workplace is a subject of increased public awareness and governmental attention. El Departamento de Salud aconseja que una de cada cuatro personas experimente un problema de salud mental en algún momento de su vida. Aunque algunos acontecimientos e iniciativas recientes han planteado el perfil de esta cuestión crucial, los empleadores están experimentando problemas para promover la salud mental y el bienestar de sus empleados. El bienestar mental en el lugar de trabajo contiene orientación experta para mejorar la salud mental y apoyar a los enfermos mentales.

Este amplio libro aborda la gama de temas relacionados con la salud mental y el bienestar en entornos laborales, proporcionando a todos los involucrados asistencia informativa y práctica. Los autores Gill Hasson y Donna Butler examinan el entorno laboral cambiante para mejorar el bienestar, cambiar las actitudes de los empleadores y empleados en materia de salud mental, posibles soluciones a los desafíos actuales y futuros y más. Estudios de casos detallados en el mundo real ilustran una variedad de preocupaciones asociadas tanto desde la perspectiva del empleador como del empleado. Esta importante guía:

Explica por qué la comprensión de la salud mental es importante y su impacto en las empresas y empleados
Discute por qué y cómo promover la salud mental en el lugar de trabajo y la importancia de tener una 'estrategia de bienestar' eficaz
Proporciona orientación sobre la gestión del personal que sufre enfermedades mentales
Direcciones relativas al estrés y la ansiedad de los empleados
Características de recursos para mayor apoyo si se experimentan problemas de salud mental
Introduce el concepto de ser un ‘preceptor activo’ y su papel en la creación de un entorno laboral más seguro e inclusivo
Incluye enlaces actualizados a las investigaciones y sitios web pertinentes para su lectura y apoyo

Salud mental y bienestar en el lugar de trabajo, Second Edition es un recurso valioso para aquellos en el lugar de trabajo que quieren cuidar de su bienestar físico y mental, y aquellos que buscan orientación en la gestión del personal con problemas de salud mental.

title: Parallel and Concurrent Programming in Haskell
description:
If you have a working knowledge of Haskell, this hands-on book shows you how to use the language’s many APIs and frameworks for writing both parallel and concurrent programs. You’ll learn how parallelism exploits multicore processors to speed up computation-heavy programs, and how concurrency enables you to write programs with threads for multiple interactions.

Author Simon Marlow walks you through the process with lots of code examples that you can run, experiment with, and extend. Divided into separate sections on Parallel and Concurrent Haskell, this book also includes exercises to help you become familiar with the concepts presented:

Express parallelism in Haskell with the Eval monad and Evaluation Strategies
Parallelize ordinary Haskell code with the Par monad
Build parallel array-based computations, using the Repa library
Use the Accelerate library to run computations directly on the GPU
Work with basic interfaces for writing concurrent code
Build trees of threads for larger and more complex programs
Learn how to build high-speed concurrent network servers
Write distributed programs that run on multiple machines in a network
translatedDescription:
Si usted tiene un conocimiento de trabajo de Haskell, este libro práctico le muestra cómo utilizar las muchas API y marcos del lenguaje para escribir programas paralelos y concurrentes. Usted aprenderá cómo el paralelismo explota procesadores multicore para acelerar los programas de computación-heavy, y cómo la concurrencia le permite escribir programas con hilos para múltiples interacciones.

Autor Simon Marlow te lleva a través del proceso con muchos ejemplos de código que puedes ejecutar, experimentar y extender. Dividido en secciones separadas sobre Parallel y Concurrent Haskell, este libro también incluye ejercicios para ayudarte a familiarizarte con los conceptos presentados:

Paralelismo Express en Haskell con la monada Eval y estrategias de evaluación
Paralelizar el código común Haskell con la monada Par
Construir computaciones paralelas basadas en arrays, utilizando la biblioteca Repa
Utilice la biblioteca Acelerar para ejecutar computaciones directamente en la GPU
Trabajar con interfaces básicas para escribir código concurrente
Construir árboles de hilos para programas más grandes y complejos
Aprende cómo construir servidores de red simultáneos de alta velocidad
Escribir programas distribuidos que funcionan en múltiples máquinas en una red

title: Your Body: The Missing Manual
description:
What, exactly, do you know about your body? Do you know how yourimmune system works? Or what your pancreas does? Or the myriad --and often simple -- ways you can improve the way your bodyfunctions?

This full-color, visually rich guide answers these questions andmore. Matthew MacDonald, noted author of Your Brain: TheMissing Manual, takes you on a fascinating tour of your bodyfrom the outside in, beginning with your skin and progressing toyour vital organs. You'll look at the quirks, curiosities, andshortcomings we've all learned to live with, and pick up justenough biology to understand how your body works. You'll learn:

That you shed skin more frequently than snakes do

Why the number of fat cells you have rarely changes, no matterhow much you diet or exercise -- they simply get bigger orsmaller

How you can measure and control fat

That your hair is made from the same stuff as horses'hooves

That you use only a small amount of the oxygen you inhale

Why blood pressure is a more important health measure thanheart rate -- with four ways to lower dangerously high bloodpressure

Why our bodies crave foods that make us fat

How to use heart rate to shape an optimal workout session --one that's neither too easy nor too strenuous

Why a tongue with just half a dozen taste buds can identifythousands of flavors

Why bacteria in your gut outnumbers cells in your body -- andwhat function they serve

Why we age, and why we can't turn back the clock

What happens to your body in the minutes after you die

Rather than dumbed-down self-help or dense medical text,Your Body: The Missing Manual is entertaining and packedwith information you can use. It's a book that may well change yourlife.

Reader comments for Your Brain: The Missing Manual,also by author Matthew MacDonald:

"Popular books on the brain are often minefields of attractive butinaccurate information. This one manages to avoid most of the hypeand easy faulty generalizations while providing easy to read anddigest information about the brain. It has useful tricks withoutthe breathless hype of many popular books." -- Elizabeth Zwicky,The Usenix Magazine

"...a unique guide that should be sought after by any who want tomaximize what they can accomplish with their mental abilities andresources." -- James A. Cox, The Midwest Book Review - WisconsinBookwatch

"If you can't figure out how to use your brain after reading thisguide, you may want to return your brain for another." -- TheSacramento Book Review, Volume 1, Issue 2, Page 19

"It's rare to find a book on any technical subject that is as wellwritten and readable as Your Brain: The Missing Manual. The bookcovers pretty much anything you may want to know about your brain,from what makes it up, through how it develops to how to mitigatethe affects of aging. The book is easy reading, fact packed andhighlighted notes and practical applications. So if you want tolearn more about your brain, how it works, how to get the best outof it or just want to stave off the ravages of Alzheimers (seechapter ten for details of how learning helps maintain your brain)then I can't recommend this book highly enough." -- Neil Davis,Amazon.co.uk

"MacDonald's writing style is perfect for this kind of guide. Itremains educational without becoming overly technical or usingunexplained jargon. And even though the book covers a broad scopeof topics, MacDonald keeps it well organized and easy to follow.The book captures your attention with fun facts and interestingstudies that any person could apply to their own understanding ofhuman ability. It has great descriptions of the brain and itsinterconnected parts, as well as providing full color pictures anddiagrams to offer a better explanation of what the author istalking about." -- Janica Unruh, Blogcritics Magazine
translatedDescription:
¿Qué, exactamente, sabes de tu cuerpo? ¿Sabes cómo funciona tu sistema inmunológico? ¿O qué hace tu páncreas? ¿O la miríada --y a menudo simple -- maneras que puede mejorar la forma en que sus funciones corporales?

Esta guía de todo color, visualmente rica responde a estas preguntas y más. Matthew MacDonald, reconocido autor de Su Cerebro: El Manual de Falta, le lleva en un fascinante recorrido por su cuerpo desde el exterior, comenzando con su piel y progresando a sus órganos vitales. Verás los quirks, curiosidades, y los saltos con los que todos aprendimos a vivir, y recogeremos una biología justa para entender cómo funciona tu cuerpo. Aprenderás:

Que derrames la piel con más frecuencia que las serpientes

¿Por qué el número de células grasas que usted tiene raramente cambios, sin importar cuánto usted dieta o ejercicio - simplemente consigue mayor orsmaller

Cómo medir y controlar la grasa

Que tu pelo está hecho de las mismas cosas que los caballos

Que usas sólo una pequeña cantidad de oxígeno que inhala

¿Por qué la presión arterial es una medida de salud más importante que la tasa de corazón - con cuatro maneras de bajar peligrosamente la presión arterial alta

Por qué nuestros cuerpos anhelan alimentos que nos hacen engordar

Cómo utilizar la frecuencia cardíaca para dar forma a una sesión de entrenamiento óptima --una que no es demasiado fácil ni demasiado dura

¿Por qué una lengua con media docena de papilas gustativas puede identificar miles de sabores

title: Make: Electronic Music from Scratch
description: Electronic Music from Scratch is a complete crash course in the joys of musical circuitry. Taking inspiration from famous instruments in electronic music history, this guide shows readers how to create dozens of whimsical, unexpected, and incredibly usable musical instruments. Create oscillators that compose their own melodies based on candle flickers, cassette players with keyboard attachments, a talkbox for scaring younger relatives, and so, so much more. Written with total beginners in mind, Electronic Music from Scratch will take readers on a journey through music history and lead them to discover sounds they didn't even know existed.

title: Artificial Intelligence-Based System Models in Healthcare
description:
Artificial Intelligence-Based System Models in Healthcare provides a comprehensive and insightful guide to the transformative applications of AI in the healthcare system.

This book is a groundbreaking exploration of the synergies between artificial intelligence and healthcare innovation. In an era where technological advancements are reshaping the landscape of medical practices, this book provides a comprehensive and insightful guide to the transformative applications of AI in healthcare systems. From conceptual foundations to practical implementations, the book serves as a roadmap for understanding the intricate relationships between AI-based system models and the evolution of healthcare delivery.

The first section delves into the fundamental role of technology in reshaping the healthcare landscape. With a focus on daily life activities, decision support systems, vision-based management, and semantic frameworks, this section lays the groundwork for understanding the pivotal role of AI in revolutionizing traditional healthcare approaches. Each chapter offers a unique perspective, emphasizing the intricate integration of technology into healthcare ecosystems.

The second section takes a deep dive into specific applications of AI, ranging from predictive analysis and machine learning to deep learning, image analysis, and biomedical text processing. With a focus on decision-making support systems, this section aims to demystify the complex world of AI algorithms in healthcare, offering valuable insights into their practical implications and potential impact on patient outcomes.

The final section addresses the modernization of healthcare practices and envisions the future landscape of AI applications. From medical imaging and diagnostics to predicting ventilation needs in intensive care units, modernizing health record maintenance, natural language processing, chatbots for medical inquiries, secured health insurance management, and glimpses into the future, the book concludes by exploring the frontiers of AI-driven healthcare innovations.

Audience

This book is intended for researchers and postgraduate students in artificial intelligence and the biomedical and healthcare sectors. Medical administrators, policymakers and regulatory specialists will also have an interest.

En una época en la que los avances tecnológicos están remodelando el paisaje de las prácticas médicas, este libro proporciona una guía integral y perspicaz a las aplicaciones transformadoras de la IA en los sistemas sanitarios. Desde las bases conceptuales hasta las implementaciones prácticas, el libro sirve como una hoja de ruta para comprender las relaciones intrincadas entre los modelos de sistemas basados en IA y la evolución de la prestación sanitaria.

La primera sección profundiza en el papel fundamental de la tecnología en la remodelación del paisaje sanitario. Esta sección, centrada en las actividades cotidianas, los sistemas de apoyo a las decisiones, la gestión basada en la visión y los marcos semánticos, sienta las bases para comprender el papel fundamental de la IA en la revolución de los enfoques tradicionales de salud. Cada capítulo ofrece una perspectiva única, enfatizando la integración intrincada de la tecnología en los ecosistemas sanitarios.

La segunda sección lleva una profunda inmersión en aplicaciones específicas de IA, que van desde el análisis predictivo y el aprendizaje automático hasta el aprendizaje profundo, el análisis de imágenes y el procesamiento de textos biomédicos. Con un enfoque en los sistemas de apoyo a la toma de decisiones, esta sección pretende desmitificar el complejo mundo de algoritmos de IA en la salud, ofreciendo valiosas ideas sobre sus implicaciones prácticas y el impacto potencial en los resultados de los pacientes.
