Audiencia

Este libro está destinado a investigadores y estudiantes de posgrado en inteligencia artificial y en los sectores biomédico y sanitario. Los administradores médicos, los encargados de formular políticas y los especialistas en reglamentación también tendrán interés.

title: Raspberry Pi Pico DIY Workshop
description:
Raspberry Pi Pico DIY Workshop provides a comprehensive introduction to the Raspberry Pi Pico microcontroller, leveraging its capabilities for innovative applications. Through step-by-step guidance and hands-on projects, you will learn to execute exciting projects in automation, health, gardening, and citizen science.

What this Book will help me do

Gain a thorough understanding of the RP2040 peripherals and their real-world applications.
Explore programming the Raspberry Pi Pico with popular languages like MicroPython and CircuitPython.
Develop and complete projects like a weather station, gardening helper, and citizen science tools.
Understand how to integrate additional hardware with the Raspberry Pi Pico to enhance its functionality.
Master the best practices for embedded product development using Raspberry Pi Pico components.

Author(s)

Sai and Srihari Yamanoor are skilled technologists and makers with a passion for empowering others in the world of embedded systems. With extensive experience across domains like IoT and robotics, they bring practical expertise and innovative project ideas into their writing. Their approachable teaching style makes complex topics accessible for readers.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for tech enthusiasts ranging from students and educators to engineers and hobbyists who are interested in embedded systems and DIY projects. Whether you're a beginner eager to explore the Raspberry Pi Pico or an experienced maker looking to broaden your skills, this book provides valuable insights.

title: Deep Learning for Robot Perception and Cognition
description:
Deep Learning for Robot Perception and Cognition introduces a broad range of topics and methods in deep learning for robot perception and cognition together with end-to-end methodologies. The book provides the conceptual and mathematical background needed for approaching a large number of robot perception and cognition tasks from an end-to-end learning point-of-view. The book is suitable for students, university and industry researchers and practitioners in Robotic Vision, Intelligent Control, Mechatronics, Deep Learning, Robotic Perception and Cognition tasks.
Presents deep learning principles and methodologies
Explains the principles of applying end-to-end learning in robotics applications

title: Exploring Raspberry Pi
description:
Expand Raspberry Pi capabilities with fundamental engineering principles

Exploring Raspberry Pi is the innovators guide to bringing Raspberry Pi to life. This book favors engineering principles over a 'recipe' approach to give you the skills you need to design and build your own projects. You'll understand the fundamental principles in a way that transfers to any type of electronics, electronic modules, or external peripherals, using a "learning by doing" approach that caters to both beginners and experts. The book begins with basic Linux and programming skills, and helps you stock your inventory with common parts and supplies. Next, you'll learn how to make parts work together to achieve the goals of your project, no matter what type of components you use. The companion website provides a full repository that structures all of the code and scripts, along with links to video tutorials and supplementary content that takes you deeper into your project.

The Raspberry Pi's most famous feature is its adaptability. It can be used for thousands of electronic applications, and using the Linux OS expands the functionality even more. This book helps you get the most from your Raspberry Pi, but it also gives you the fundamental engineering skills you need to incorporate any electronics into any project.

Develop the Linux and programming skills you need to build basic applications
Build your inventory of parts so you can always "make it work"
Understand interfacing, controlling, and communicating with almost any component
Explore advanced applications with video, audio, real-world interactions, and more

Be free to adapt and create with Exploring Raspberry Pi.

Usted comprenderá los principios fundamentales de una manera que transfiere a cualquier tipo de electrónica, módulos electrónicos o periféricos externos, utilizando un enfoque "aprendizaje haciendo" que atiende tanto a principiantes como a expertos. El libro comienza con las habilidades básicas de Linux y programación, y le ayuda a almacenar su inventario con partes y suministros comunes. A continuación, aprenderá a hacer que las piezas funcionen juntas para alcanzar las metas de su proyecto, sin importar qué tipo de componentes utilice. title: Beginning Radio Communications: Radio Projects and Theory
description:
Understanding radio communications systems unlocks a new way to look at the world and the radio waves that connect it. Through easy-to-understand instruction and a variety of hands-on projects, this book gives the reader an intuitive understanding of how radio waves propagate, how information is encoded in radio waves, and how radio communications networks are constructed.

 

This book also focuses on the world of amateur, or “ham,” radio, a global network of hobbyists that experiment and communicate with radio waves. The reader can learn what amateur radio is, how one can obtain an amateur radio license, and how various pieces of amateur radio hardware work.

 

Rather than overwhelm with formulas and numerical approaches, this book presents an easy-to-follow qualitative approach to the theory aspects of radio—perfect for those with little to no knowledge of electromagnetism, signal processing, or hardware development. Instead, instruction focuses on hands-on learning. Radio waves are easy and inexpensive to manipulate with modern hardware, so the examples throughout this text provide ample opportunity to develop an understanding of such hardware.

 

A special focus is given to applications of radio communications in the modern world. In every chapter, the reader gains new insight into different radio communications systems and the hardware and software that makes it all possible. Projects include using a software-defined radio to download live images of the Earth from weather satellites, Arduino-based digital radio communications networks, making amateur radio contacts, and more.

What You’ll Learn:

·         Encode information in radio waves

·         Obtain an amateur radio license

·         Use important pieces of radio communications hardware, such as antennas, handheld transceivers, software-defined radios, radio repeaters, and more

Who This Book Is For
Anyone interested in modern communications, from high school and college students pursuining STEM to professionals looking to broaden their understandings of radio

A través de la instrucción fácil de entender y una variedad de proyectos prácticos, este libro proporciona al lector una comprensión intuitiva de cómo se propagan las ondas de radio, cómo se codifica la información en las ondas de radio y cómo se construyen las redes de radio.



Este libro también se centra en el mundo de los aficionados, o “ham”, la radio, una red global de aficionados que experimentan y comunican con las ondas de radio. El lector puede aprender lo que es la radio amateur, cómo se puede obtener una licencia de radio amateur, y cómo funcionan varias piezas de hardware de radio amateur.



En lugar de abrumarse con fórmulas y enfoques numéricos, este libro presenta un enfoque cualitativo fácil de seguir a los aspectos teóricos de la radio-perfecto para aquellos con poco o ningún conocimiento de electromagnetismo, procesamiento de señales o desarrollo de hardware. En cambio, la instrucción se centra en el aprendizaje práctico. Las ondas de radio son fáciles y económicas para manipular con hardware moderno, por lo que los ejemplos a lo largo de este texto ofrecen una amplia oportunidad para desarrollar una comprensión de dicho hardware.



Se presta especial atención a las aplicaciones de las comunicaciones de radio en el mundo moderno. En cada capítulo, el lector obtiene una nueva visión de los diferentes sistemas de comunicaciones radiofónicas y del hardware y software que lo hace todo posible. Los proyectos incluyen el uso de una radio definida por software para descargar imágenes en vivo de la Tierra de satélites meteorológicos, redes de radiodifusión digitales basadas en Arduino, contactos radio aficionados y mucho más.

Cualquier persona interesada en las comunicaciones modernas, desde estudiantes de la secundaria y universitarios pursuining STEM a profesionales que buscan ampliar su comprensión de la radio

title: Revolutionizing Youth Mental Health with Ethical AI: Transform Youth Mental Well-being by Exploring Responsible AI and GenAI Applications
description:
This book is your comprehensive guide into the dynamic intersection of artificial intelligence (AI) and youth mental health. It aims to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI technology and its transformative potential in addressing youth mental health challenges.

 

The book's content is structured into three key parts, each focusing on different facets of AI applications in youth mental health. The first part provides a comprehensive background on the current state of youth mental health, analyzing the prevalence of mental health issues and identifying the unique challenges faced by the digital generation. In the second part, we explore the foundational principles of AI and its potential for revolutionizing mental health care, including natural language processing, machine learning, and predictive analytics. In this section, you will find in-depth case studies and real-world applications that showcase how AI-driven interventions have already transformed mental health care for youth across diverse contexts. Finally, the third part delves into ethical considerations, fairness, privacy concerns, and the responsible integration of AI in youth mental health care to design long-term sustainable solutions.

 

This book offers a unique and holistic perspective, making it an indispensable resource for anyone passionate about leveraging AI for the betterment of youth mental health. Through this book, you will gain the knowledge and tools needed to design and implement effective AI-driven solutions that have the potential to transform the mental health landscape for the benefit of future generations.

 

What You Will Learn

Understand the current state of youth mental health, exploring the prevalence of mental health issues among the digital generation
Understand natural language processing, machine learning, and predictive analytics
Know how AI interventions are already transforming mental health care for youth in diverse contexts
Be aware of fairness, privacy concerns, and the responsible integration of AI in youth mental health care
Get familiar with the role of GenAI in the mental health domain and how AI agents can be a game-changer

 

Who This Book Is For

To equip academics and researchers in the AI, computer science, and digital mental health domain as well as AI application developers with a deeper understanding of how AI-powered innovations can enhance the well-being of youth; and innovation managers and policymakers who are interested in exploring the AI use cases

Qué aprenderás

title: Programming with 64-Bit ARM Assembly Language: Single Board Computer Development for Raspberry Pi and Mobile Devices
description:
Mastering ARM hardware architecture opens a world of programming for nearly all phones and tablets including the iPhone/iPad and most Android phones. It’s also the heart of many single board computers like the Raspberry Pi. Gain the skills required to dive into the fundamentals of the ARM hardware architecture with this book and start your own projects while you develop a working knowledge of assembly language for the ARM 64-bit processor.

You'll review assembly language programming for the ARM Processor in 64-bit mode and write programs for a number of single board computers, including the Nvidia Jetson Nano and the Raspberry Pi (running 64-bit Linux). The book also discusses how to target assembly language programs for Apple iPhones and iPads along with 64-Bit ARM based Android phones and tablets. It covers all the tools you require, the basics of the ARM hardware architecture, all the groups of ARM 64-Bit Assembly instructions, and how data is stored in the computer’s memory. In addition, interface apps to hardware such as the Raspberry Pi’s GPIO ports. The book covers code optimization, as well as how to inter-operate with C and Python code. Readers will develop enough background to use the official ARM reference documentation for their own projects.

With Programming with 64-Bit ARM Assembly Language as your guide you’ll study how to read, reverse engineer and hack machine code, then be able to apply these new skills to study code examples and take control of both your ARM devices’ hardware and software.
What You'll Learn
Make operating system calls from assembly language and include other software libraries in your projects
Interface apps to hardware devices such as the Raspberry Pi GPIO ports
Reverse engineer and hack code
Use the official ARM reference documentation for your own projects
Who This Book Is For
Software developers who have already learned to program in a higher-level language like Python, Java, C#, or even C and now wish to learn Assembly programming.

Obtenga las habilidades necesarias para sumergirse en los fundamentos de la arquitectura de hardware ARM con este libro y comenzar sus propios proyectos mientras desarrolla un conocimiento de trabajo del lenguaje de montaje para el procesador ARM 64-bit.

Usted revisará la programación de lenguaje de montaje para el procesador ARM en modo de 64 bits y escribirá programas para una serie de computadoras de tablero individuales, incluyendo el Nvidia Jetson Nano y el Raspberry Pi (correr Linux de 64 bits). Aplicaciones de interfaz para dispositivos de hardware como los puertos Raspberry Pi GPIO
Ingeniero inverso y código de hackeo
Utilice la documentación oficial de referencia ARM para sus propios proyectos
Quién es este libro
Desarrolladores de software que ya han aprendido a programar en un lenguaje de alto nivel como Python, Java, C#, o incluso C y ahora desean aprender la programación de la Asamblea.

title: Sensor Projects with Raspberry Pi: Internet of Things and Digital Image Processing
description:
Use Python to develop Rasperry Pi projects to solve common digital image processing and IoT problems. Using a free IoT server you’ll tackle fundamental topics and concepts behind theses two areas. This second edition includes new content on Artificial Intelligence and updated sensor guidance to help you better explore virtual animations, create a homemade spectrometer, and master object classification with Edge Impulse.

Start by creating a system to detect movement with a PIR motion sensor and a Raspberry Pi board. Use the MQ2 gas sensor and a Raspberry Pi board as a gas leak alarm system to detect dangerous explosive and fire hazards. Then train your system to send the captured data to the remote server ThingSpeak. You’ll also develop a weather station with your Raspberry Pi. Using the DHT11 (humidity and temperature sensor) and BMP (barometric pressure and temperature sensor) in conjunction with ThingSpeak and X, you can receive real time weather alerts from your own meterological system!

Spectral sensers used with the Raspberry Pi include the AS7262 (six colors), and AS7263 (near infrared) for the construction of a filter spectrometer, sensing colored solutions, and assessing plant foliage health. Finally, expand your skills into the popular machine learning world of digital image processing using OpenCV and a Pi. Make your own object classifiers and finally manipulate an object by means of an image in movement. This skillset has many applications, ranging from recognizing people or objects, to creating your own video surveillance system.

With the skills gained from Sensor Projects with Raspberry Pi, you'll be well-equipped to explore other applications in mobile development and electrical engineering as well. 

What You'll Learn

Work with ThingSpeak to receive X alerts from your systems.
Cultivate skills in processing sensor inputs that are applicable to mobile and machine learning projects.
Incorporate sensors into projects to make interactive devices.
Experiment with virtual scenarios and objects.
Create Python and Pygame games that contain virtual scenarios and animations.
Detect colored solutions and assess the plant foliage health.

Who This Book Is For

Hobbyists and makers working with robotics and IoT. Electronic engineers and programmers who would like to expand their familiarity with basic sensor projects.
translatedDescription:

Usando un servidor IoT gratuito, abordarás temas y conceptos fundamentales detrás de estas dos áreas. Esta segunda edición incluye nuevo contenido en Inteligencia Artificial y guía de sensores actualizada para ayudarte a explorar las animaciones virtuales, crear un espectrómetro casero y clasificación de objetos maestros con Edge Impulse.

Comience por crear un sistema para detectar el movimiento con un sensor de movimiento PIR y un tablero Raspberry Pi. Utilice el sensor de gas MQ2 y un tablero Raspberry Pi como sistema de alarma de fuga de gas para detectar peligrosos riesgos de incendio y explosivos. Entonces entrena tu sistema para enviar los datos capturados al servidor remoto ThingSpeak. También desarrollará una estación meteorológica con su Raspberry Pi. Usando el DHT11 (sensor de humedad y temperatura) y BMP (sensor de presión y temperatura barométricas) junto con ThingSpeak y X, usted puede recibir alertas meteorológicas en tiempo real de su propio sistema metrológico!

Los sensers espectrales utilizados con el Raspberry Pi incluyen el AS7262 (seis colores), y AS7263 (cerca de infrarrojos) para la construcción de un espectrómetro de filtro, detección de soluciones de color, y evaluación de la salud del follaje vegetal. Finalmente, expande sus habilidades en el popular mundo de aprendizaje automático del procesamiento digital de imágenes utilizando OpenCV y un Pi. Haz tus propios clasificadores de objetos y finalmente manipula un objeto por medio de una imagen en movimiento. Este destreza tiene muchas aplicaciones, desde reconocer personas o objetos, hasta crear su propio sistema de videovigilancia.

Con las habilidades obtenidas de Sensor Projects con Raspberry Pi, usted estará bien equipado para explorar otras aplicaciones en el desarrollo móvil e ingeniería eléctrica también.

Lo que aprenderás

Trabaja con ThingSpeak para recibir alertas X de tus sistemas.
Cultivar habilidades en el procesamiento de entradas de sensores que son aplicables a los proyectos de aprendizaje móvil y automático.
Incorporar sensores en proyectos para hacer dispositivos interactivos.
Experimenta con escenarios y objetos virtuales.
Cree juegos de Python y Pygame que contengan escenarios y animaciones virtuales.
Detectar soluciones coloreadas y evaluar la salud del follaje vegetal.

Quién es este libro

Hobbyists and makers working with robotics and IoT. Ingenieros y programadores electrónicos que quieran ampliar su familiaridad con los proyectos de sensores básicos.

title: Intelligent Robots and Cobots
description:
The book provides a comprehensive study of how new technological advances utilize robots and Cobots (collaborative robots that work safely alongside humans) to increase manufacturing efficiency.

Industry 5.0 focuses on using collaborative robots, or cobots, enabling users to design with greater freedom. This book, structured into 18 chapters and three sections - Fundamentals; Applications; and Challenges – reflect the current and emerging market trends that shape industrial growth. Each chapter explores how businesses incorporating hardware and software like AI, cognitive computing, blockchain, IIoT, and more—are capitalizing on these innovations to maintain a competitive edge. The research and development in the areas of technology has increased the cost-effectiveness and acceptance of these IoT-enabled devices in many different industries. Various sectors including manufacturing, healthcare, transportation, and agriculture sectors, have begun incorporating robots and cobots into their operations. They are aiming to increase their productivity, reduce the downtime of their equipment, and optimize resource utilization.

The individual chapters examine the following subjects:

Investigation on Deployment of Microservices for Swarm Intelligence of Collaborative Robots • Cobot-Aided System for Hydroponically Grown Plants • Low/No-Code Software Development of Cobots Using Advanced Graphical User Interface • Role of Cobots Over Industrial Robots in Industry 5.0 Activities • Cobot Collaboration in the Healthcare Industry • Robotic Arm for Industry Automation • Artificial Intelligence–Driven Cobots for Innovative Industry 5.0 Workforce • Comprehensive Analysis on Design, Working, and Manufacturing of Soft Robots • Workforce for Industry 5.0: The Work of Future and the Future of Work • Security Issues and Trends of Industrial Robots and Cobots • Aviation Bots for Decongesting Airports • Self-Contained Study and Evolution of Cobots in Intelligent Transportation Systems • Smart Architecture for Data Analytics in Collaborative Robots • Contribution of Blockchain Technology for the Cobot’s Cybersecurity Issues • Security Issues and Trends of Industrial Robots and Cobots • Cloud-Based Cobots for Industry 5.0: A Human-Centric Solution • Future Workforce for Industry 5.0.

Audience

The book’s primary audience is researchers and post-graduate students in robotics and cobots, industrial engineers, production and manufacturing engineers working on artificial intelligence and logistics.

Industry 5.0 se centra en el uso de robots colaborativos, o cobots, permitiendo a los usuarios diseñar con mayor libertad. Este libro, estructurado en 18 capítulos y tres secciones - Fundamentos, Aplicaciones y Desafíos - refleja las tendencias de mercado actuales y emergentes que conforman el crecimiento industrial. La investigación y el desarrollo en las esferas de la tecnología han aumentado la eficacia en función de los costos y la aceptación de estos dispositivos habilitados para el IoT en muchas industrias diferentes. Varios sectores, entre ellos los sectores manufacturero, sanitario, de transporte y agrícola, han comenzado a incorporar robots y cobotes en sus operaciones. Audiencia

El público principal del libro son investigadores y estudiantes de posgrado en robótica y cobots, ingenieros industriales, ingenieros de producción y fabricación que trabajan en inteligencia artificial y logística.

title: Automate Your Home Using Go
description:
Take control of your home and your data with the power of the Go programming language. Build extraordinary and robust home automation solutions that rival much more expensive, closed commercial alternatives, using the same tools found in high-end enterprise computing environments. Best-selling Pragmatic Bookshelf authors Ricardo Gerardi and Mike Riley show how you can use inexpensive Raspberry Pi hardware and excellent, open source Go-based software tools like Prometheus and Grafana to create your own personal data center. Using the step-by-step examples in the book, build useful home automation projects that you can use as a blueprint for your own custom projects.

With just a Raspberry Pi and the Go programming language, build your own personal data center that coordinates and manages your home automation, leveraging the same high-powered software used by large enterprises. The projects in this book are easy to assemble, no soldering or electrical engineering expertise required.

Build a temperature monitor that can send alerts any time defined thresholds are exceeded and report the temperature readings on a time-based series chart. Change the color of lights to visually indicate the current outdoor weather status. Create a networked motion detector that triggers an alert any time motion is detected, such as a door opening or closing, a pet wandering around, or deliveries or visitors arriving on your front porch. Even have these triggers initiate a more complex Go-based automation sequence. Integrate a small, high-resolution camera into a bird feeder that takes excellent, up-close photos whenever a bird perches at the feeder, and broadcasts them to your Discord server where your family and friends can see these wildlife captures in real time.

Control your home with hardware you configure, and manage it with Go code that you create and modify any time you want to enhance your home automation capabilities.

What You Need:

Readers should be familiar with the Go programming language and have working knowledge of Linux. Free, open source Go-based libraries and utilities are available for download from the Internet. Readers will also need a working Raspberry Pi 3+ or higher, and a Pi Pico W microcontroller. Several other inexpensive electronic parts (touch sensors, motion detectors) are also needed for some of the projects. A Philips Hue base lighting system is also needed for the weather monitor project.

Utilizando los ejemplos paso a paso en el libro, construye proyectos útiles de automatización doméstica que puedes utilizar como un plan para tus propios proyectos personalizados.

Con sólo un lenguaje de programación Raspberry Pi y Go, construye tu propio centro de datos personal que coordina y gestiona tu automatización de casa, aprovechando el mismo software de alta potencia utilizado por grandes empresas. Cambiar el color de las luces para indicar visualmente el estado actual del tiempo al aire libre. Cree un detector de movimiento en red que active una alerta en cualquier momento que se detecte movimiento, como una apertura de puerta o un cierre, una mascota vagando alrededor, o entregas o visitantes llegando en su porche delantero. A Philips El sistema de iluminación base de Hue también es necesario para el proyecto de monitor meteorológico.

title: Drone Technology
description:
DRONE TECHNOLOGY

This book provides a holistic and valuable insight into the revolutionary world of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV).

The book elucidates the revolutionary and riveting research in the ultramodern domain of drone technologies, drone-enabled IoT applications, and artificial intelligence-based smart surveillance. The book explains the most recent developments in the field, challenges, and future scope of drone technologies. Beyond that, it discusses the importance of a wide range of design applications, drone/UAV development, and drone-enabled smart healthcare systems for smart cities. It describes pioneering work on mitigating cyber security threats by employing intelligent machine learning models in the designing of IoT-aided drones. The book also has a fascinating chapter on application intrusion detection by drones using recurrent neural networks. Other chapters address interdisciplinary fields like artificial intelligence, deep learning, the role of drones in healthcare in smart cities, and the importance of drone technology in agriculture.

Audience

The book will be read and consulted by a range of industry engineers involved with introducing drone technology to their daily operations.

TECNOLÓGICO

El libro diluye la investigación revolucionaria y fascinante en el dominio ultramoderno de tecnologías de drones, aplicaciones de IoT habilitadas por drones y vigilancia inteligente artificial basada en inteligencia. El libro explica los acontecimientos más recientes en el campo, los desafíos y el futuro alcance de las tecnologías de drones. Más allá de eso, se habla de la importancia de una amplia gama de aplicaciones de diseño, desarrollo de drones/UAV y sistemas de salud inteligentes habilitados para drones para ciudades inteligentes. Describe el trabajo pionero en la mitigación de las amenazas de seguridad cibernética empleando modelos inteligentes de aprendizaje automático en el diseño de drones IoT-aided. El libro también tiene un fascinante capítulo sobre detección de intrusión de aplicaciones por drones utilizando redes neuronales recurrentes. Otros capítulos abordan campos interdisciplinarios como la inteligencia artificial, el aprendizaje profundo, el papel de los drones en la salud en las ciudades inteligentes, y la importancia de la tecnología de drones en la agricultura.

Audiencia

El libro será leído y consultado por una serie de ingenieros de la industria involucrados en la introducción de tecnología de drones a sus operaciones diarias.

title: Essential Computer Hardware
description:
"Essential Computer Hardware" by Kevin Wilson is an in-depth exploration of the fundamental components that make up modern computers. Through this comprehensive guide, readers will understand the interplay between hardware components, peripheral devices, and their interactions with software, as well as foundational concepts in internet security. The book provides an accessible yet detailed approach to mastering computer hardware.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the function and interconnection of core computer components.
Familiarize with various types of computer peripherals and their purposes.
Analyze and discern hardware specifications for making informed decisions.
Explore the relationship between hardware and software in computational systems.
Develop foundational knowledge in internet security to protect digital assets.

Author(s)

Kevin Wilson is an experienced technical educator and author specializing in hardware systems and computer security. He has authored multiple books on computing and has an engaging and practical approach to explaining technical topics. With decades of applied experience, Kevin brings clarity and accessibility to complex subjects, making his works invaluable to both beginners and professionals.

Who is it for?

"Essential Computer Hardware" is designed for individuals aiming to build a robust understanding of computer hardware, peripherals, and the fundamentals of internet security. This book suits beginners with no background in technology, as well as professionals seeking to deepen their understanding of computer hardware. For students and educators alike, it serves as an excellent resource for learning and teaching the basics of computing systems, offering practical knowledge for everyday decision-making in technology.

title: Programming Robots with ROS
description: Want to develop novel robot applications, but don’t know how to write a mapping or object recognition system? You’re certainly not alone, but you’re not without help. By combining real-world examples with valuable knowledge from the Robot Operating System (ROS) community, this practical book provides a set of motivating recipes for solving specific robotics use cases.

Ciertamente no estás solo, pero no estás sin ayuda. Al combinar ejemplos reales con valiosos conocimientos de la comunidad Robot Operating System (ROS), este práctico libro ofrece un conjunto de recetas motivadoras para resolver casos específicos de uso robótico.

title: Internet of Things from Scratch
description:
In "Internet of Things from Scratch," you'll explore the fundamentals of IoT technology, from essential hardware like ESP32 and Raspberry Pi to robust cloud platforms like AWS. Packed with practical insights, this book equips you with the knowledge and skills to build and manage complex IoT applications suited for the needs of Industry 4.0.

What this Book will help me do

Gain insights into IoT architecture and hardware, including sensors and microcontrollers.
Master IoT networking principles and communication protocols.
Learn to integrate IoT solutions with cloud services like AWS for scalability.
Develop proficiency in securing IoT systems and mitigating cybersecurity risks.
Explore the role of AI and data analytics in enhancing IoT applications, including generative AI.

Author(s)

Renaldi Gondosubroto is a skilled professional in the field of IoT systems and technology. With extensive experience in working with industry-level IoT solutions, Renaldi blends a pragmatic approach to teaching IoT with a focus on clarity and accessibility. Through hands-on examples and detailed explanations, Renaldi guides readers step-by-step to effectively design IoT systems.

Who is it for?

This book is designed for beginners to intermediate IoT practitioners, including engineers, developers, and enthusiasts interested in building IoT capacities. It is accessible to those with foundational programming skills and familiarity with microcontrollers. Readers aiming to master IoT towards practical industry applications will find this book highly valuable.

Es accesible para aquellos con habilidades de programación fundamental y familiaridad con los microcontroladores. Los lectores que buscan dominar IoT hacia aplicaciones prácticas de la industria encontrarán este libro muy valioso.

title: Make: Volume 94
description:
Film and television create amazing worlds, but sometimes you want a piece of those worlds you can hold in your hands. In this issue of Make: we show how to create your own tangible props and models from movies, TV, and your own imagination. Join pro model maker and Tested alum Kayte Sabicer as she re-creates an epic replica of the Off-World Blimp from Blade Runner. Go behind the scenes (and back in time) to see how The Wizard of Oz used miniatures and practical effects to create the stunning tornado scene that still holds up today! Star Wars was instrumental in putting fan builds on the map, and we check in with the bevy of droid builders who re-create everything from classic R2-D2 to Disney's adorable new "duckling droids" from the Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge theme park. Or maybe you want smaller-scale models to go with your tabletop war games? Learn how to paint, weather, and "trashbash" everyday junk into new mini terrain, buildings, and vehicles to create your own worlds. Plus, 19 projects, including:
Scale down The Mandalorian's "Volume" video wall for your own mini movie virtual production
Use simple cardboard to make a custom articulated robot costume
Build robust, network-controlled light-up wearables for group costumes and performances
Create a personal light show with a Teensy-powered, xLights-animated display
3D print and launch your own custom compressed air rockets
Use an Oxocard microcontroller and servo to make an electronic cuckoo clock
Meet Flipper Zero and friends' learn about the latest hacker multitools
And much more!

Únete a la creadora de modelos profesionales y alumna testada Kayte Sabicer mientras re-crea una réplica épica del Off-World Blimp de Blade Runner. Vaya detrás de las escenas (y de nuevo en el tiempo) para ver cómo el mago de Oz usó miniaturas y efectos prácticos para crear la escena de tornado impresionante que todavía se mantiene hoy! Star Wars fue instrumental en la creación de ventiladores en el mapa, y revisamos con la envidia de los constructores de droides que re-crean todo desde el clásico R2-D2 a los adorables "duckling droids" de Disney de las Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge parque temático. ¿O tal vez quieras modelos de menor escala para ir con tus juegos de mesa de guerra? Escala abajo La pared de video "Volumen" de Mandalorian para su propia producción virtual de mini película
Utilice cartón simple para hacer un traje de robot articulado personalizado
Construir robustos y controlados por la red para disfraces y performances de grupo
Crear un espectáculo de luz personal con una pantalla con motor de adolescentes, con rayos XLights
Imprimir y lanzar sus propios cohetes de aire comprimido personalizados
Utilice un microcontrolador de Oxocard y servo para hacer un reloj de cuco electrónico
Conoce a Flipper Zero y los amigos aprenden sobre los últimos hacker multitools
¡Y mucho más!

title: Skill Seeker: Young Maker Edition
description: How do you motivate kids to learn new STEM skills and put them on a path toward science and engineering? Turn it into a game! Skill Seeker: Young Maker Edition uses "skill trees" to chart a path toward proficiency in subjects like 3D printing, sewing, and robotics, enabling them to see their learning progress. Activities such as creating cardboard sculptures and wearable tech provide a launching point for exploration and inspiration. Ignite the curiosity of young minds!

Buscador de habilidades: Young Maker Edition utiliza "armas de matar" para trazar un camino hacia la competencia en temas como impresión 3D, costura y robótica, lo que les permite ver su progreso de aprendizaje. Actividades como la creación de esculturas de cartón y tecnología usable proporcionan un punto de lanzamiento para la exploración y la inspiración. ¡Enciende la curiosidad de las mentes jóvenes!

title: Make: Volume 92
description:
Wow, it’s been 20 years since Make: magazine hit newsstands and mailboxes. We wouldn’t be here without you! To celebrate, we got the original magazine team back together to give a behind-the-scenes look at creating the very first issue, and asked Fab Labs guru Neil Gershenfeld and visionary tech publisher Tim O’Reilly to look back at 20 years of the Maker Movement. Plus, check out all 90+ Make: magazine covers! But that’s not all. Our annual Digital Fabrication deep dive explores the coolest high-tech tools for your workshop. New laser cutters — CO2, diode, and fiber — have more power and lower prices than ever. See our breakdown of “what cuts what” to pick the right type for your cutting needs. Then, check out innovative new 3D printers and CNC machines — or build your own handheld CNC router that automatically helps you cut the right path. Plus, 23 projects, including:

Use a heat gun, flour sifter, and pizza pan to build the ultimate DIY coffee roaster
3D-print lace fabrics for making garments or decor — no 3D modeling skills required
Build a rugged water turbine for $50 and generate 200 watts of any-time power
Use our new Oxocard Connect microcontroller to build a timed Smartphone Safe and take a break from your screen
Hack a clever toy and a robot arm to make a bubble-blowing companion robot
And much more!

Además, ver todos los 90+ Hacer: las portadas de la revista! Pero eso no es todo. Nuestra inmersión anual Digital Fabrication profunda explora las herramientas de alta tecnología más frescas para su taller. Los nuevos cortadores láser — CO2, diodo y fibra— tienen más potencia y precios más bajos que nunca. Vea nuestro desglose de “qué corta qué” para elegir el tipo adecuado para sus necesidades de corte. Luego, echa un vistazo a nuevas impresoras 3D y máquinas CNC innovadoras, o construye tu propio router CNC portátil que te ayuda automáticamente a cortar el camino correcto. Además, 23 proyectos, entre ellos:

Use una pistola de calor, un tamiz de harina y una sartén de pizza para construir el último asador de café DIY
Tejidos de encaje 3D para fabricar prendas o decoración, sin necesidad de habilidades de modelado 3D
Construir una turbina de agua robusta por $50 y generar 200 vatios de energía en cualquier momento
Utilice nuestro nuevo microcontrolador Oxocard Connect para construir un teléfono inteligente templado seguro y tomar un descanso de su pantalla
Hack un juguete inteligente y un brazo robot para hacer un robot compañero de burbujas
¡Y mucho más!

title: Deep Dive into Power Automate: Learn by Example
description:
Understand the basics of flow and learn how to implement guidelines in real-life scenarios, including Robotic Process Automation (RPA) capabilities. This book covers the evolution of flow and how it is transformed to a full-fledged RPA (such as Power Automate).

The book starts with an introduction to flow and its transformation to Process Automation. You will learn how to create a Power Automate environment and demonstrate different types of flows within it. Author Goloknath Mishra takes you through various types of cloud flows and their best practices. Desktop Flows (RPA) or Power Automate Desktop (PAD) is discussed and the author teaches you its architecture, installation steps, and how to manage, schedule, and share a desktop. You will learn about Business Process Flow, Process Advisors, and AI Builder. You also will go through licensing considerations in Power Automate and AI Builder, and demonstrate all of your learnings through a mini project.

After reading thebook, you will have gained expertise in Power Automate and be able to implement its guidelines and solve problems at your organization.

What Will You Learn

Know the difference between Intelligent Process Automation (IPA) and Robotic Process Automation (RPA)
Understand the different types of flows in Power Automate
Create various types of cloud flows, Desktop flows, Business Process flows, and AI Builder models
Study common use cases and be aware of Power Automate best practices

Who This Book Is For

Business executives, citizen developers, IT professionals, and computer scientists who wish to efficiently automate monotonous work
translatedDescription:
Entender los fundamentos del flujo y aprender cómo implementar las directrices en escenarios de la vida real, incluyendo las capacidades de automatización del proceso robótico (RPA). Este libro cubre la evolución del flujo y cómo se transforma en un RPA completo (como Power Automate).

El libro comienza con una introducción al flujo y su transformación a la automatización del proceso. Aprenderás a crear un entorno Power Automate y demostrarás diferentes tipos de flujos dentro de él. Autor Goloknath Mishra te lleva a través de varios tipos de flujos de nubes y sus mejores prácticas. Flujos de escritorio (RPA) o Power Automate Desktop (PAD) se discuten y el autor le enseña su arquitectura, pasos de instalación, y cómo gestionar, programar y compartir un escritorio. Aprenderá acerca de Flujo de Procesos de Negocios, Asesores de Procesos y Constructor de AI. También pasará por consideraciones de licencia en Power Automate y AI Builder, y demostrará todos sus aprendizajes a través de un mini proyecto.

Después de leer el libro, usted habrá obtenido experiencia en Power Automate y será capaz de implementar sus directrices y resolver problemas en su organización.

Qué aprenderás

Conoce la diferencia entre la automatización del proceso inteligente (IPA) y la automatización del proceso robótico (RPA)
Comprender los diferentes tipos de flujos en Power Automate
Crear varios tipos de flujos de nube, flujos de escritorio, flujos de proceso de negocios y modelos AI Builder
Estudie casos de uso común y conozca las mejores prácticas de Power Automate

Quién es este libro

Ejecutivos de negocios, desarrolladores ciudadanos, profesionales de TI y científicos informáticos que desean automatizar eficientemente el trabajo monótono

title: Internet of Things Programming Projects - Second Edition
description:
In Internet of Things Programming Projects, you will explore the practical aspects of building IoT systems using Raspberry Pi 5 and Raspberry Pi Pico. The book guides you through a series of engaging projects, teaching you the tools, techniques, and coding necessary to construct innovative IoT designs.

What this Book will help me do

Create weather indicator systems using Raspberry Pi and Python to showcase real-time data.
Develop IoT-enabled autonomous robot cars that utilize ROS for advanced control.
Integrate LoRa technology into environmental monitoring projects to extend communication ranges.
Build IoT alarm modules and notification systems for home security purposes.
Leverage MQTT and web services for seamless IoT data communication and presentation.

Author(s)

Colin Dow, an experienced programmer and IoT developer, brings his expertise as a technical educator with years of experience in various industries. His practical approach effectively demystifies IoT concepts and guides learners with clarity and precision.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for IoT enthusiasts, programmers with a basic understanding of IoT or coding, and Raspberry Pi hobbyists looking to expand their skills. It caters equally to beginners eager to get started with hands-on projects and advanced users seeking to implement complex IoT solutions.
translatedDescription:
En Internet de Cosas Proyectos de Programación, explorará los aspectos prácticos de la construcción de sistemas IoT utilizando Raspberry Pi 5 y Raspberry Pico. El libro le guía a través de una serie de proyectos atractivos, enseñándole las herramientas, técnicas y codificación necesarias para construir diseños innovadores de IoT.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Cree sistemas de indicador meteorológico utilizando Raspberry Pi y Python para mostrar datos en tiempo real.
Desarrollar autos robot autónomos habilitados para IoT que utilizan ROS para un control avanzado.
Integrar la tecnología LoRa en proyectos de vigilancia ambiental para ampliar los rangos de comunicación.
Construir módulos de alarma IoT y sistemas de notificación para fines de seguridad en el hogar.
Leverage MQTT and web services for seamless IoT data communication and presentation.

Autor(s)

Colin Dow, un experimentado programador y desarrollador de IoT, aporta su experiencia como educador técnico con años de experiencia en diversas industrias. Su enfoque práctico desmitifica eficazmente los conceptos y guías de IoT con claridad y precisión.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para entusiastas de IoT, programadores con una comprensión básica de IoT o codificación, y los hobbyistas de Raspberry Pi que buscan expandir sus habilidades. Sirve igualmente para principiantes deseosos de empezar con proyectos prácticos y usuarios avanzados que buscan implementar soluciones complejas de IoT.

title: Understand HashiCorp Vault API
description: Vault is the leading secrets management tool for controlling access to sensitive credentials in low-trust environments and encrypting data in transit. The reader will learn to deploy a production grade vault service, leverage vault roles and policies, and implement data protection strategies.
translatedDescription: Vault es la principal herramienta de gestión de secretos para controlar el acceso a credenciales sensibles en entornos de baja confianza y cifrar datos en tránsito. El lector aprenderá a desplegar un servicio de bóveda de grado de producción, apalancar funciones y políticas de bóveda, e implementar estrategias de protección de datos.

title: Internet of Things for Architects
description:
Dive into the rapidly evolving world of IoT with "Internet of Things for Architects." This book provides a comprehensive exploration of IoT systems, guiding you through the design and implementation of architectures that incorporate sensors, communication protocols, security frameworks, and data analytics. Discover actionable insights and best practices to create scalable, robust IoT solutions.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the architecture of IoT systems, from sensors to cloud applications.
Learn the functionality of communication protocols like Bluetooth 5.0 and 5G for IoT.
Apply best practices in IoT system security, incorporating reliable safeguards.
Grasp the principles of data analytics, including deep learning, for IoT.
Develop a holistic understanding of engineering domains relevant to IoT architecture.

Author(s)

Perry Lea has over 27 years of experience in IoT, computer architecture, and embedded systems. With his expertise in cloud services and edge computing technologies, Perry brings an in-depth perspective on IoT engineering. His approachable writing style makes complex topics accessible, empowering readers to design innovative, scalable systems.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for technology architects, developers looking to transition into IoT, and tech managers aiming to broaden their understanding of IoT solutions. Suitable for professionals with a foundational grasp of engineering concepts, it provides in-depth knowledge of IoT architectures. Readers will gain tools and frameworks to design systems tailored to their industry needs.
translatedDescription:
Sumérgete en el mundo en rápida evolución de IoT con "Internet de las cosas para Arquitectos". Este libro proporciona una exploración completa de los sistemas IoT, guiándole a través del diseño e implementación de arquitecturas que incorporan sensores, protocolos de comunicación, marcos de seguridad y análisis de datos. Descubra ideas y mejores prácticas para crear soluciones IoT escalables y robustas.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Comprender la arquitectura de los sistemas IoT, desde sensores hasta aplicaciones cloud.
Aprende la funcionalidad de protocolos de comunicación como Bluetooth 5.0 y 5G para IoT.
Aplicar las mejores prácticas en la seguridad del sistema IoT, incorporando salvaguardias confiables.
Grasp the principles of data analytics, including deep learning, for IoT.
Desarrollar una comprensión holística de los dominios de ingeniería relevantes para la arquitectura IoT.

Autor(s)

Perry Lea tiene más de 27 años de experiencia en IoT, arquitectura informática y sistemas integrados. Con su experiencia en servicios en la nube y tecnologías de computación de bordes, Perry aporta una perspectiva profunda sobre la ingeniería de IoT. Su estilo de escritura accesible hace que los temas complejos sean accesibles, habilitando a los lectores para diseñar sistemas innovadores y escalables.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para arquitectos tecnológicos, desarrolladores que buscan la transición hacia IoT, y gerentes de tecnología que buscan ampliar su comprensión de las soluciones de IoT. Adecuado para profesionales con una comprensión fundamental de los conceptos de ingeniería, proporciona un conocimiento profundo de las arquitecturas de IoT. Los lectores ganarán herramientas y marcos para diseñar sistemas adaptados a sus necesidades industriales.

title: Making Things Move DIY Mechanisms for Inventors, Hobbyists, and Artists
description:
Get Your Move On!

In Making Things Move: DIY Mechanisms for Inventors, Hobbyists, and Artists, you'll learn how to successfully build moving mechanisms through non-technical explanations, examples, and do-it-yourself projects--from kinetic art installations to creative toys to energy-harvesting devices. Photographs, illustrations, screen shots, and images of 3D models are included for each project.

This unique resource emphasizes using off-the-shelf components, readily available materials, and accessible fabrication techniques. Simple projects give you hands-on practice applying the skills covered in each chapter, and more complex projects at the end of the book incorporate topics from multiple chapters. Turn your imaginative ideas into reality with help from this practical, inventive guide.

Discover how to:

Find and select materials
Fasten and join parts
Measure force, friction, and torque
Understand mechanical and electrical power, work, and energy
Create and control motion
Work with bearings, couplers, gears, screws, and springs
Combine simple machines for work and fun

Projects include:

Rube Goldberg breakfast machine
Mousetrap powered car
DIY motor with magnet wire
Motor direction and speed control
Designing and fabricating spur gears
Animated creations in paper
An interactive rotating platform
Small vertical axis wind turbine
SADbot: the seasonally affected drawing robot

Make Great Stuff! TAB, an imprint of McGraw-Hill Professional, is a leading publisher of DIY technology books for makers, hackers, and electronics hobbyists.

Combine máquinas simples para el trabajo y la diversión

Motor DIY con alambre magnético
Dirección de motor y control de velocidad

Creaciones animadas en papel
Una plataforma rotativa interactiva
Pequeña turbina de eje vertical
SADbot: el robot de dibujo afectados estacionalmente

title: Telecommunications Essentials
description:
Praise for Telecommunications Essentials

“In Telecommunications Essentials, Goleniewski guides us through the ever-changing world of telecommunications with much sense and a great deal of style. Her wide ranging and in-depth study into this complex field is superbly researched and written. Its emphasis on learning and technology is thought-provoking and never fails to be relevant to the field today. It is essential reading.”

—Chris Barclay, Director, Strategy & Planning, Retail, Telstra

Her material is now captured in this book, which should rightfully grace any self-respecting technical collection.”

—Dr. Bob Horton, Deputy Chairman, Australian Communications Authority

“If you need one good reference book on telecom, this is it. It’s comprehensive, easy to understand, and up-to-date on latest technology—definitely a must-have for both beginners and professionals.”

—To Chee Eng, Principal Anaylst, Telecoms and Internet, Gartner Group

“Lili Goleniewski is a gifted communicator and educator who combines clear explanation of complex technologies with a firm grasp of the dynamic commercial environment in which those technologies are being deployed. The author’s extensive international experience in communicating to an audience drawn from diverse cultures and differing levels of familiarity with technical concepts and the English language enables her to enliven subject matter that otherwise can be dauntingly unapproachable. I commend this book to anyone seeking to develop their understanding of developing communications technologies, regardless of their technical background.”

—Peter Leonard, Managing Partner, Technology and Communications, Gilbert & Tobin Lawyers

Lili applies a matter-of-fact style and laces this with humor and the occasional wonder to weave all the complex building blocks of the telecommunications industry into a readable book. The book will be a permanent fixture on my ‘go to find an answer’ reference list.”

—Kiron Chatterjee, Koshen Holdings and Former CEO of Asia Online

“Telecommunication Essentials is an excellent high-level view of telecom. It provides interesting examples of actual and potential applications in telecom. This is an extraordinarily useful and timely book.”

—Natasha K. Zaslove, Lawyer

Telecommunications Essentials approaches the subject unlike typical academic or reference texts—instead, it tells stories, effectively and engagingly explaining the new culture evolving around telecommunications, with just the right amount of relevant technical details. Data Communications

Frame Relay, ATM

Internet Infrastructure

VPNs, VoIP, Streaming Media

Broadband Architectures

Security

Optical Networking

Cable

Wireless

Fiber

The broadband home

title: Business Data Communications and Networking, Eleventh Edition
description: The 11th edition of FitzGerald and Dennis' Business Data Communications and Networking focuses on more comprehensive updating, as well as more hands-on and applied exercises. The new edition has more in-depth coverage of routing; revisions and updates on wireless; additional cases for team-based learning; and more hands-on lab exercises. In general, this text has more details in many chapters, specific updates, and updated illustrations.

La nueva edición tiene una cobertura más profunda de la enrutamiento; revisiones y actualizaciones sobre inalámbrico; casos adicionales para el aprendizaje basado en equipo; y ejercicios de laboratorio más prácticos. En general, este texto tiene más detalles en muchos capítulos, actualizaciones específicas e ilustraciones actualizadas.

title: THE IMS: IP Multimedia Concepts and Services, 3rd Edition
description:
The IMS builds on the success of the first two editions to provide comprehensive coverage of IMS: its concepts, architecture, protocols and functionalities. It has been completely revised to include a number of new chapters which replace superseded topics, while remaining chapters are updated. In part 1, more information on TISPAN, I-WLAN, Cable is included and chapters are added on subjects such as 'IMS transit', 'Communication Continuity (VCC / PS-2-PS Handover)' and 'IMS interconnection'. Part 2 contains two new chapters on 'Multimedia Telephony' and 'SMS over IMS' while part 3 is completely updated with chapters added on 'Interworking' and 'Voice Call Continuity'. Part IV – Protocols, of the previous edition will be added to a new companion website.

New edition of highly successful text

Includes a number of new chapters while remaining chapters are fully revised and updated

New companion website to include Protocols

Places special emphasis on services, featuring more detailed descriptions of presence, messaging, group management and push-to-talk over cellular (conferencing).

Explores the general benefits of IMS in detail and focuses in particular on its role in fixed-mobile convergence.
translatedDescription:
El IMS se basa en el éxito de las dos primeras ediciones para proporcionar una cobertura integral del IMS: sus conceptos, arquitectura, protocolos y funcionalidades. Se ha revisado completamente para incluir una serie de nuevos capítulos que sustituyen temas superpuestos, mientras que los capítulos restantes se actualizan. En la parte 1, se incluye más información sobre TISPAN, I-WLAN, Cable y se agregan capítulos sobre temas como 'acceso de IM', 'Continuidad de comunicación (VCC / PS-2-PS Handover)' y 'Interconexión de IMS'. La parte 2 contiene dos nuevos capítulos sobre 'Multimedia Telephony' y 'SMS over IMS', mientras que la parte 3 está completamente actualizada con capítulos añadidos sobre 'Interworking' y 'Voice Call Continuity'. title: Orchestrating and Automating Security for the Internet of Things: Delivering Advanced Security Capabilities from Edge to Cloud for IoT
description:
Discover high-value Azure security insights, tips, and operational optimizations

Master powerful techniques and approaches for securing IoT systems of all kinds–current and emerging

 

Internet of Things (IoT) technology adoption is accelerating, but IoT presents complex new security challenges. Fortunately, IoT standards and standardized architectures are emerging to help technical professionals systematically harden their IoT environments. In Orchestrating and Automating Security for the Internet of Things, three Cisco experts show how to safeguard current and future IoT systems by delivering security through new NFV and SDN architectures and related IoT security standards.

 

The authors first review the current state of IoT networks and architectures, identifying key security risks associated with nonstandardized early deployments and showing how early adopters have attempted to respond. Next, they introduce more mature architectures built around NFV and SDN. You’ll discover why these lend themselves well to IoT and IoT security, and master advanced approaches for protecting them. Finally, the authors preview future approaches to improving IoT security and present real-world use case examples.

 

This is an indispensable resource for all technical and security professionals, business security and risk managers, and consultants who are responsible for systems that incorporate or utilize IoT devices, or expect to be responsible for them.

 

· Understand the challenges involved in securing current IoT networks and architectures

· Master IoT security fundamentals, standards, and modern best practices

· Systematically plan for IoT security

· Leverage Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and Network Function Virtualization (NFV) to harden IoT networks

· Deploy the advanced IoT platform, and use MANO to manage and orchestrate virtualized network functions

· Implement platform security services including identity, authentication, authorization, and accounting

· Detect threats and protect data in IoT environments

· Secure IoT in the context of remote access and VPNs

· Safeguard the IoT platform itself

· Explore use cases ranging from smart cities and advanced energy systems to the connected car

· Preview evolving concepts that will shape the future of IoT security ..

title: Why Rome Fell
description:
Explore an insightful and original discussion of the causes of the fall of the Roman Empire

In Why Rome Fell: Decline and Fall, or Drift and Change?, celebrated scholar of Roman history Dr. Michael Arnheim delivers a fascinating and robust exploration of the causes of and reasons for Rome’s fall in the West. Steeped in applications of elite theory to the later Roman Empire, the author discusses several interconnected issues that influenced the decline of Rome, including monarchy, power structure, social mobility, religion, and the aristocratic ethos.

Incisive comparisons of the situation in Rome to those in the Principate and the Byzantine Empire shed light on the relative lack of “indissoluble union and easy obedience” (in Gibbon’s phrase) in the later Roman Empire. Instead, the book reveals the divided loyalties of a fractured society that characterized Rome in its later years. Why Rome Fell also includes:

A thorough introduction to the transition from the ancient to the medieval world, including discussions of monarchy, Diocletian and his relationship to the aristocracy, and Constantine’s reforms
Comprehensive explorations of the rise of the Roman Christian empire and Constantine’s role
Practical discussions of conflicting theories of what caused the fall of the Roman empire, including the Pirenne thesis, the malaria hypothesis, Gibbon’s ‘decline and fall’ theory, and the role played by religion

An indispensable resource for students, scholars and the general reader with an inquiring mind about history, Why Rome Fell deserves a place on the bookshelves of anyone with an interest in a sophisticated and original take on historical continuity and change.

Robado en aplicaciones de la teoría de la élite al Imperio Romano posterior, el autor discute varios temas interconectados que influyeron en el declive de Roma, incluyendo la monarquía, la estructura de poder, la movilidad social, la religión y el ethos aristocrático.

Comparaciones incisivas de la situación en Roma con los del Principado y el Imperio Bizantino arrojaron luz sobre la relativa falta de “sindicación indisoluble y obediencia fácil” (en la frase de Gibbon) en el Imperio Romano posterior. En cambio, el libro revela las lealtades divididas de una sociedad fracturada que caracterizó a Roma en sus años posteriores. Por qué Roma Fell también incluye:

Una introducción exhaustiva a la transición del mundo antiguo al medieval, incluyendo discusiones de la monarquía, Diocleciano y su relación con la aristocracia, y las reformas de Constantino
