Prepárate para definir el rendimiento, medirlo, ayudar a los empleados a mejorarlo, y alinear el desempeño de los empleados con los objetivos estratégicos y prioridades de su organización.

title: Learning Digital Identity
description:
Why is it difficult for so many companies to get digital identity right? If you're still wrestling with even simple identity problems like modern website authentication, this practical book has the answers you need. Author Phil Windley provides conceptual frameworks to help you make sense of all the protocols, standards, and solutions available and includes suggestions for where and when you can apply them.

By linking current social login solutions to emerging self-sovereign identity issues, this book explains how digital identity works and gives you a firm grasp on what's coming and how you can take advantage of it to solve your most pressing identity problems. VPs and directors will learn how to more effectively leverage identity across their businesses.

This book helps you:

Learn why functional online identity is still a difficult problem for most companies
Understand the purpose of digital identity and why it's fundamental to your business strategy
Learn why "rolling your own" digital identity infrastructure is a bad idea
Differentiate between core ideas such as authentication and authorization
Explore the properties of centralized, federated, and decentralized identity systems
Determine the right authorization methods for your specific application
Understand core concepts such as trust, risk, security, and privacy
Learn how digital identity and self-sovereign identity can make a difference for you and your organization
translatedDescription:
¿Por qué es difícil para tantas empresas obtener la identidad digital correcta? Si sigues luchando con problemas de identidad simples como la autenticación del sitio web moderno, este libro práctico tiene las respuestas que necesitas. Autor Phil Windley proporciona marcos conceptuales para ayudarle a tener sentido de todos los protocolos, estándares y soluciones disponibles e incluye sugerencias para dónde y cuándo puede aplicarlos.

Al vincular las soluciones de acceso social actuales a los problemas emergentes de identidad auto-sovereign, este libro explica cómo funciona la identidad digital y te da una comprensión firme de lo que viene y cómo puedes aprovecharla para resolver tus problemas de identidad más apremiantes. VPs y directores aprenderán cómo aprovechar más eficazmente la identidad en sus negocios.

Este libro te ayuda:

Aprende por qué la identidad funcional en línea sigue siendo un problema difícil para la mayoría de las empresas
Comprender el propósito de la identidad digital y por qué es fundamental para su estrategia empresarial
Aprende por qué "rollar tu propia" infraestructura de identidad digital es una mala idea
Diferenciar entre ideas básicas como autenticación y autorización
Explore las propiedades de los sistemas de identidad centralizados, federados y descentralizados
Determinar los métodos de autorización adecuados para su aplicación específica
Entender conceptos básicos como confianza, riesgo, seguridad y privacidad
Aprenda cómo la identidad digital y la identidad auto-sovereign pueden marcar una diferencia para usted y su organización

title: Power of People, The: Learn How Successful Organizations Use Workforce Analytics To Improve Business Performance, 1/e
authors: Jonathan Ferrar Nigel Guenole Sheri Feinzig
description: Learn from Today’s Most Successful Workforce Analytics Leaders Transforming the immense potential of workforce analytics into reality isn’t easy. Pioneering practitioners have learned crucial lessons that can help you succeed. The Power of People shares their journeys—and their indispensable insights. Drawing on incisive case studies and vignettes, three experts help you bring purpose and clarity to any workforce analytics project, with robust research design and analysis to get reliable insights. title: Identity Security for Software Development
description:
Maintaining secrets, credentials, and machine identities in secure ways is an important, though often overlooked, aspect of secure software development. DevOps security often addresses vulnerabilities, but it neglects broader discussions like authentication, authorization, and access control, potentially leaving the door open for breaches. That's where an identity security strategy integrated in your code, infrastructure, and environments from day one can help.

In this practical book, authors John Walsh, Uzi Ailon, and Matt Barker provide conceptual frameworks, technology overviews, and useful code snippets to bridge the gap between development, IT, and security to integrate robust identity security across apps, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes and cloud native, hybrid and multicloud, process automation, IoT, and more. You'll learn:

What developers need to know about managing secrets and identity to build safer apps
What machine identities, secrets, and credentials are—and how to secure them
How to secure the software supply chain to build safer apps
How identity security fits into modern software development practices

title: Combatting Cyber Terrorism - A guide to understanding the cyber threat landscape and incident response planning
description:
Combatting Cyber Terrorism – A guide to understanding the cyber threat landscape and incident response planning

In his second book with IT Governance Publishing, Richard Bingley’s Combatting Cyber Terrorism – A guide to understanding the cyber threat landscape and incident response planning analyses the evolution of cyber terrorism and what organisations can do to mitigate this threat.   

This book discusses:

Definitions of cyber terrorism;
Ideologies and idealisations that can lead to cyber terrorism;
How threat actors use computer systems to diversify, complicate and increase terrorist attack impacts;
The role of Big Tech and social media organisations such as X (formerly Twitter) and Instagram within the cyber threat landscape; and
How organisations can prepare for acts of cyber terrorism via security planning and incident response strategies such as ISO 31000, ISO 27001 and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.

Increasingly, cyber security practitioners are confronted with a stark phrase: cyber terrorism. For many, it conveys fear and hopelessness. What is this thing called ‘cyber terrorism’ and what can we begin to do about it?

Malicious-minded ICT users, programmers and even programs (including much AI-powered software) have all been instrumental in recruiting, inspiring, training, executing and amplifying acts of terrorism. This has resulted in the loss of life and/or life-changing physical injuries that could never have occurred without support and facilitation from the cyber sphere. These types of attacks can be encapsulated by the phrase ‘cyber terrorism’. 

The Internet is an integral part of everyday life for the vast majority of organisations and people. Web access has become viewed as an essential human right, and a prerequisite of citizenship and societal belonging.

Despite well-meaning interventions by a range of influential stakeholders (tech companies, governments, police and academia), our computer networks remain riddled with cyber threats. Accessing terrorism content does not require much in the way of research skills, technical ability or patience.

This book recounts case studies to show the types of threats we face and provides a comprehensive coverage of risk management tactics and strategies to protect yourself against such nefarious threat actors. These include key mitigation and controls for information security or security and HR-related professionals.
translatedDescription:
Lucha contra el ciberterrorismo – Una guía para entender el panorama de amenazas cibernéticas y la planificación de la respuesta a incidentes

En su segundo libro con IT Governance Publishing, Richard Bingley's Combatting Cyber Terrorism – Una guía para entender el panorama de amenazas cibernéticas y la planificación de respuestas a incidentes analiza la evolución del ciberterrorismo y qué organizaciones pueden hacer para mitigar esta amenaza.

Este libro discute:

Definiciones de terrorismo cibernético;
ideologías e idealizaciones que pueden conducir al ciberterrorismo;
:: La forma en que los agentes amenazados utilizan sistemas informáticos para diversificar, complicar y aumentar los efectos de los ataques terroristas;
El papel de Big Tech y organizaciones de redes sociales como X (antes Twitter) e Instagram dentro del panorama de amenazas cibernéticas; y
Cómo las organizaciones pueden prepararse para actos de ciberterrorismo mediante estrategias de planificación de la seguridad y respuesta a incidentes como ISO 31000, ISO 27001 y el Marco de Seguridad Cibernética NIST.

Cada vez más, los profesionales de la seguridad cibernética se enfrentan a una frase escalofriante: el ciberterrorismo. Para muchos, transmite el miedo y la desesperanza. ¿Qué es lo que se llama “terrorista cíbero” y qué podemos empezar a hacer al respecto?

Los usuarios, programadores e incluso programas de tecnologías de la información y las comunicaciones maliciosas (incluidos muchos programas de inteligencia artificial) han sido fundamentales para reclutar, inspirar, entrenar, ejecutar y amplificar los actos de terrorismo. Esto ha dado lugar a la pérdida de vidas y/o lesiones físicas cambiantes que nunca podrían haber ocurrido sin el apoyo y la facilitación de la esfera cibernética. Estos tipos de ataques pueden ser encapsulados por la frase “terrorista cíbero”.

Internet es parte integral de la vida cotidiana para la gran mayoría de organizaciones y personas. El acceso a la Web se ha convertido en un derecho humano esencial y un requisito previo de ciudadanía y pertenencia social.

A pesar de las intervenciones bien significativas de una serie de actores influyentes (empresas tecnológicas, gobiernos, policía y academias), nuestras redes informáticas siguen estando plagadas de amenazas cibernéticas. El acceso al contenido del terrorismo no requiere mucho en la forma de habilidades de investigación, capacidad técnica o paciencia.

Este libro cuenta estudios de casos para mostrar los tipos de amenazas que enfrentamos y proporciona una cobertura completa de tácticas y estrategias de gestión de riesgos para protegerse contra tales actores de amenazas nefastas. These include key mitigation and controls for information security or security and HR-related professionals.

title: Creepy Analytics: Avoid Crossing the Line and Establish Ethical HR Analytics for Smarter Workforce Decisions
description: Discover how to develop and implement an HR analytics system that benefits employees, as well as your organization The potential of HR analytics is a major discussion among scholars, practitioners, thought leaders, and technology vendors, with companies like Amazon, Apple, Google, and Meta digging deeply into HR research and analytics practices that extend beyond simple metrics, scorecards, and reporting. Additionally, ethical questions have begun to arise about the potential abuses of HR analytics with respect to technological advancements and the “datafication” of personal—and often trivial—characteristics, preferences, and behaviors that have little relevance to job performance. As a former chief human resources officer, head of Global HR Research and Analytics at a Fortune 100, and thought leader on this subject, Salvatore Falletta has witnessed first-hand the emergence of “creepy analytics” as a hot-button issue. In this one-of-a-kind guide, Falletta delivers a proven step-by-step process for establishing HR analytics capabilities that serve employees and organizations alike. You’ll learn how to rethink and redefine HR analytics, determine stakeholder requirements, gather and transform data, communicate intelligence results, and establish an ethical ecosystem to ensure HR analytics remains a force for good.

Además, se han empezado a plantear cuestiones éticas sobre los posibles abusos de la analítica de RRHH con respecto a los avances tecnológicos y la “dataficación” de las características, preferencias y comportamientos personales, y a menudo triviales, que tienen poca relevancia para el desempeño laboral. Como ex jefe de recursos humanos, jefe de Global HR Research and Analytics en una Fortune 100, y líder de pensamiento sobre este tema, Salvatore Falletta ha presenciado de primera mano el surgimiento de “análisis gigantesca” como cuestión de botones calientes. En esta guía única, Falletta ofrece un proceso probada paso a paso para establecer capacidades de análisis de recursos humanos que sirvan a empleados y organizaciones por igual. Aprenderás a repensar y redefinir la analítica de RRHHH, determinar los requisitos de los interesados, reunir y transformar datos, comunicar resultados de inteligencia y establecer un ecosistema ético para asegurar que la analítica de RRHHH siga siendo una fuerza para el bien.
